sections.text: Left-sided sciatica, with numbness. Paralysis of single parts. Dull, tearing pain in hands and arms. Heaviness and weakness. Tearing joints. Unsteadiness of *muscles of forearm* and hand. Numbness; loss of sensation in hands. *Contracted tendons*. Weak ankles. Cannot walk without suffering. *Rheumatic tearing in limbs; better by warmth, especially heat of bed*. Burning in joints. Slow in learning to walk. Unsteady walking and easily falling. *Restless legs at night*. Cracking and tension in knees; stiffness in hollow of knee. Itching on dorsum of feet.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Soreness in folds of skin, back of ears, between thighs. *Warts* large, jagged, bleeding easily, on tips of fingers and nose. Old burns that do not get well, and ill effects from burns. Pains of burns. Cicatrices freshen up; old injuries reopen. Skin prone to intertrigo during dentition.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Very drowsy; can hardly keep awake. Nocturnal sleeplessness, with dry heat, inquietude.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
According to the careful investigations of Dr. Wagner of Basel, Causticum corresponds to Ammon causticum 4x. *Causticum* does not agree with *Phosphorus*; the remedies should not be used after each other. *Diphtherotoxin follows*, causticum in chronic bronchitis.
Antidote: Paralysis from lead-poisoning.
Complementary: *Carbo; Petrosel*.
Compare: *Rhus; Arsenic; Amm phos* (facial paralysis).

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, dry, cold winds, in *clear fine* weather, *cold* air; from motion of carriage. *Better*, *in damp, wet weather; warmth*. Heat of bed.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to thirtieth attenuation. In chronic ailments and especially in paralytic states, the higher potencies once or twice a week.

remedies.heading: CEANOTHUS AMERICANUS
remedies.intro: This remedy seems to possess a specific relation to the spleen. Ague cake of malaria. A left-sided remedy generally. Anaemic patients where liver and spleen are at fault. Chronic bronchitis with profuse secretion. Marked blood pressure, reducing powers. Active hemastatic, materially reducing the clotting of blood.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Enormous enlargement of the spleen. *Splenitis; pain all up the left side*. Deep-seated pain in left hypochondrium, hypertrophy of spleen. Leucaemia. Violent dyspnoea. Menses profuse, and yellow weakening leucorrhoea. Unable to lie on left side. Pain in liver and back.

sections.heading: Rectum
sections.text: Diarrhoea; bearing down in abdomen and rectum.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Constant urging to urinate. Green; frothy; contains bile, sugar.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: *Tinospora cordifolia* (a Hindoo medicine for chronic cases of fever with enlarged spleen). *Polymnia uvedalia*-Bearsfoot--(acute splenitis with tenderness over left hypochondriac region; spleen enlarged, ague cake. Vascular atony, tissues sodden, flabby and non-elastic. Enlarged glands; influences all ductless glands). *Ceanothus thrysiflorus*-California Lilac--(Pharyngitis, tonsillitis, nasal catarrh, diphtheria. Tincture internally and as a gargle).
Compare: *Berberis; Myrica; Cedron; Agaricus* (spleen).

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, motion, lying on left side.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First attenuation. Locally as hair tonic.

remedies.heading: CEDRON
remedies.intro: Periodicity is the most marked characteristic of this drug. Its particularly useful in tropical or in damp, warm, marshy countries. It has been found curative in malarial affections, especially neuralgia. Adapted to persons of a voluptuous disposition, excitable, nervous temperament. Has powers of antidoting snake-bites and stings of insects. Tincture of pure bean scraped on wound. Mania.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Pain from temple to temple across eyes. Pain over whole right side of face, coming on about 9 am.Crazy feeling from pain across forehead; worse, working on black. Roaring in ears produced by Cinchona. Whole body seems numb with headache.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Shooting over left eye. Severe *pain in eyeball, with radiating pains around eye*, shooting into nose. Scalding lachrymation. *Supra-orbital neuralgia periodic*. Iritis, choroiditis.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Lancinating pain in joints; worse, feet and hands. Sudden pain in ball of right thumb, extending up arm to shoulder. Pain in ball of right foot, extending to knee. Shingles, with radiating pain. Dropsy of knee-joint.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Chilliness towards evening; then frontal headache extending into parietal region. Red eyes. Heat, with itching of eyes, tearing in limbs, *numbness of limbs*.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidote: *Lach*.
Compare: *Ars; China*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture to third attenuation.

remedies.heading: CENCHRIS CONTORTRIX
remedies.intro: Like the other snake poisons, it affects the system profoundly. Like arsenic, it has dyspnoea, mental and physical restlessness, thirst for small quantities of water, necessity for having clothing loose, like Laches. Marked alternation of moods; vivid dreams. Is a wonderful restorative and deep acting remedy. Increased sexual desire in both sexes. Ineffectual attempts to recline. Right ovarian region painful.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Forgetful, absent-minded, alternating moods. Aching pain in left frontal eminence and left side of teeth. Swelling around eyes, aching and itching in eyes.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Feels distended, fills whole chest, as if it fell down in abdomen; sharp stitches, fluttering under left scapula.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Dreams horrible and vivid; lascivious.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, pressure; lying down; afternoon and night.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Ars; Laches. Clotho Arictans--*Puff Adder.--Should have a great sphere of usefulness in many conditions where excessive swelling is a leading feature (John H. Clarke, M. D).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Sixth potency.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Great desire to work and to be doing something useful.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Occipital headache and *pain through the globe of the eyes and orbits* (*Cedron; Onos*). Pain across the brain from left to right. Pain along right malar bone running to temple.

sections.heading: Chest
sections.text: Convulsive pains at the heart; feels as if transfixed. Pain in chest through heart, with pain running toward spleen. Pain in left pectoral muscle and cartilages of left lower ribs. Sensation of a great weight on heart, and pricking pain. Hypertrophy of heart. Difficult, sighing respiration, as from some compression of chest.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Itching of skin (*Dolich; Sulph*).

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Pain in neck, back, shoulders, down arms, hands and fingers. Pain in knees and joints of lower extremities.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Cactus; Spigel; Kalmia; Cereus serpentinus* (Very irritable with tendency to swear; wild anger and low morals. Disturbance in speech; in writing leaves off the last syllable. Paralyzed feeling. Pains in heart, and dwindling of sexual organs. Emissions, followed by pain in testicles).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to sixth attenuation.

remedies.heading: CERIUM OXALICUM
remedies.intro: Spasmodic reflex vomiting and spasmodic cough are within the sphere of this remedy. *Vomiting of pregnancy*, and of half-digested food. Whooping cough, with vomiting and haemorrhage. Dysmenorrhoea in fleshy, robust women. Better when flow is established.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Ingluvin*--(made from gizzard of a fowl). Vomiting of pregnancy; gastric neurasthenia. Infantile vomiting and diarrhoea. 3x Trit. *Amygdal; Lactic ac; Ipecac*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First trituration.

remedies.heading: CHAMOMILLA
remedies.intro:
The chief guiding symptoms belong to the mental and emotion group, which lead to this remedy in many forms of disease. Especially of frequent employment in diseases of children, where peevishness, restlessness, and colic give the needful indications. A disposition that is mild, calm and gentle; sluggish and constipated bowels contra-indicate chamomilla.
Chamomilla is *sensitive, irritable, thirsty, hot, and numb*. Oversensitiveness from abuse of coffee and narcotics. *Pains unendurable*, associated with numbness. Night-sweats.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: *Whining restlessness*. Child wants many things which he refuses again. Piteous moaning because he cannot have what he wants. Child can only be quieted when carried about and petted constantly. *Impatient*, intolerant of being spoken to or interrupted; extremely sensitive to every pain; always complaining. Spiteful, *snappish*. Complaints from anger and vexation. *Mental calmness contraindicates Chamom*.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Throbbing headache in one-half of the brain. Inclined to bend head backward. Hot, clammy sweat on forehead and scalp.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Ringing in ears. *Earache*, with soreness; *swelling and heat driving patient frantic*. Stitching pain. Ears feel stopped.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Lids smart. Yellow sclerotic. Spasmodic closing of lids.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Sensitive to all smells. Coryza, with inability to sleep.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: *One cheek* red and hot; the other pale and cold. Stitches in jaw extending to inner ear and teeth. *Teeth ache worse after warm drink*; worse, coffee, at night. Drives to distraction. Jerking of tongue and facial muscles. Distress of teething children (*Calc phos; Terebinth*).

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Parotid and submaxillary glands swollen. Constriction and pain as from a plug.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Toothache, if anything warm is taken, from coffee, during pregnancy. Nightly salivation.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Eructations, foul. Nausea after coffee. Sweats after eating or drinking. Aversion to warm drinks. Tongue yellow; taste bitter. Bilious vomiting. Acid rising; regurgitation of food. Bitter, bilious vomiting. Pressive gastralgia, as from a stone (*Bry; Abies n*).

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Distended. Griping in region of navel, and pain in small of back. Flatulent colic, after anger, *with red cheeks and hot perspiration*. Hepatic colic. Acute duodenitis (*Kali bich* (chronic)).

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Hot, *green*, watery, fetid, *slimy*, with colic. Chopped white and yellow mucus like chopped eggs and spinach. Soreness of anus. Diarrhoea during dentition. Haemorrhoids, with painful fissures.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Uterine haemorrhages. Profuse discharge of clotted, *dark blood, with labor-like pains*. Labor pains spasmodic; press upward (*Gels*). Patient intolerant of pain (*Caul; Caust; Gels; Hyos; Puls*). Nipples inflamed; tender to touch. Infant's breasts tender. Yellow, acrid leucorrhoea (*Ars; Sep; Sulph*).

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Hoarseness, hawking, *rawness of larynx. Irritable, dry, tickling cough*; suffocative tightness of chest, with bitter expectoration in daytime. Rattling of mucus in child's chest.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Insupportable pain in loins and hips. *Lumbago*. Stiffness of neck muscles.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text:
Violent rheumatic pains drive him out of bed at night; compelled to walk about. Burning of soles at night (*Sulph*).
*Ankles give way in the afternoon*. Nightly paralytic loss of power in the feet, unable to step on them.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Drowsiness with moaning, weeping and wailing during sleep; anxious, frightened dreams, with half-open eyes.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, by *heat*, anger, open air, wind, *night. Better*, from being carried, warm wet weather.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: *Cypriped; Anthemis; Aconite; Puls; Coffea; Bellad; Staphis; Ignat*. Follows Belladonna in diseases of children and abuse of opium. *Rubus villosus*-Blackberry--(diarrhoea of infancy; stools watery and clay colored).
Antidotes: *Camph; Nux; Puls*.
Complementary: *Bell; Mag c*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to thirtieth attenuation.

remedies.heading: CHAPARRO AMARGOSO
remedies.intro:
Chronic diarrhoea. Tenderness over liver. Stools little pain, but with much mucus. Dysentery. Acts as a tonic and antiperiodic.
Compare: *Kali carb; Cup, ars; Caps*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third attenuation.

remedies.heading: CHELIDONIUM MAJUS
remedies.intro: A prominent liver remedy, covering many of the direct reflex symptoms of diseased conditions of that organ. The jaundiced skin, and especially the *constant pain under inferior angle of right scapula*, are certain indications. Paralytic drawing and lameness in single parts. The great general lethargy and indisposition to make any effort is also marked. Ailments brought on or renewed by change of weather. *Serous effusions. Hydrocele. Bilious complication during gestation*.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Icy coldness of occiput from the nape of neck; *feels heavy as lead*. Heavy, lethargic; drowsiness very marked, with general numbness; vertigo, associated with hepatic disturbance. Inclination to fall forward. Right-sided headache down behind ears and shoulder-blade. *Neuralgia over right eye*, right cheek-bone and right ear, with excessive lachrymation, preceded by pain in liver.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Flapping of alae nasi (*Lyc*).

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Dirty yellow color of whites. Sore sensation on looking up. Tears fairly gush out. Orbital neuralgia of right eye, with profuse lachrymation; pupils contracted, relieved by pressure.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: *Yellow*; worse nose and cheeks. Wilted skin.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Tongue yellow, with imprint of teeth; large and flabby (*Merc; Hyd*). Taste bitter, pasty. Bad odor from mouth. *Prefers hot food and drink*. Nausea, vomiting; *better, very hot water*. Pain through stomach to back and right shoulder-blade. Gastralgia. *Eating relieves temporarily*, especially when accompanied with hepatic symptoms.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Jaundice due to hepatic and gall-bladder obstruction. Gall-colic. Distention. Fermentation and sluggish bowels. Constriction across, as by a string. Liver enlarged. Gallstones (*Berberis*).

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Profuse, foaming, yellow urine, like beer (*Chenop*) dark, turbid.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Constipation; stools hard, round balls, like sheep's dung, bright yellow, pasty; clay-colored, stools float in water; *alternation of diarrhoea and constipation*. Burning and itching of anus (*Ratanh; Sulph*).

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses too late and too profuse.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Very quick and short inspirations; pain on deep inspiration. Dyspnoea. Short, exhausting cough; sensation of dust not relieved by cough. Whooping-cough; spasmodic cough; loose, rattling; expectoration difficult. Pain in *right* side of chest and shoulder, with embarrassed respiration. Small lumps of mucus fly from mouth when coughing. Hoarse in afternoon. Constriction of chest.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Pain in nape. Stiff neck, head drawn to left. *Fixed pain under inner and lower angle of right scapula*. Pain at lower angle of left scapula.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text:
Pain in arms, shoulders, hands, tips of fingers.
*Icy coldness of tips of fingers*; wrists sore, tearing in metacarpal bones. Whole flesh sore to touch. Rheumatic pain in hips and thighs; intolerable pains in heels, as if pinched by too narrow a shoe; worse, right. Feels paralyzed. Paresis of the lower limbs with rigidity of muscles.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Dry heat of skin; itches, *yellow*. Painful red pimples and pustules. Old, spreading, offensive ulcers. Wilted skin. Sallow, cold, clammy.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, right side, motion, touch, change of weather, very early in morning. *Better*, after dinner, from pressure.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
*Chelidonin*.--(Spasm of smooth muscle everywhere, intestinal colic, uterine colic, bronchial spasm, tachycardia, etc). *Boldo*-Boldoa fragrans--(Bladder atony; cholecystitis and biliary calculus. Bitter taste, no appetite; constipation, hypochondriasis languor, congestion of liver; burning weight in liver and stomach. Painful hepatic diseases. Disturbed liver following malaria). *Elemuy Gauteria*--(Stones in kidneys and bladder; grain doses of powdered bark in water or 5 drops of tincture. Pellagra).
*Sulph* often completes its work.
Complementary: *Lycop; Bryon*.
Antidote: *Chamom*.
Compare: *Nux; Sulph; Bry; Lyc; Opium; Podophyl; Sanguin; Ars*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture and lower attenuations.

remedies.heading: CHELONE GLABRA
remedies.intro: A remedy in liver affections with pain or soreness of the left lobe of the liver and extending downwards. Dumb ague. Soreness of external parts, as if skin were off; debility. Malaise, following intermittents. Dyspepsia with hepatic torpor. Jaundice. *Round and thread worms*. It is an enemy to every kind of worm infesting the human body.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture, in one to five drop doses.

remedies.heading: CHENOPODIUM ANTHELMINTICUM
remedies.intro: Characteristic pain in scapula very marked. Symptoms of apoplexy, right hemiplegia, and aphasia. Stertorous breathing (*Opium*). Sudden *vertigo*. Meniere's disease. Affections of auditory nerves (*Nat salicyl*). Oil of Chenopodium for hookworm and roundworm.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Torpor of auditory nerve. Hearing better for *high-pitched* sounds. Comparative deafness to sound of voice, but *great sensitiveness to sound, as of passing vehicles* and also a shrinking from low tones. Buzzing in ears. Enlargement of tonsils. *Aural vertigo*.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: *Intense pain between angle of right shoulder-blade near spine*, and through the chest.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Copious, yellow, foaming urine, with acrid sensation in urethra. Yellowish sediment (*Chel*).

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Opium; China; Chelid*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third potency. Oil of Chenopodium for hookworm, 10 minim doses every 2 hours for 3 doses; also *Carbon tetrachloride*.

remedies.heading: CHIMAPHILA UMBELLATA
remedies.intro:
Acts principally on kidneys, and genito-urinary tract; affects also lymphatic and mesenteric glands and female mammae. Plethoric young women with dysuria. Women with large breasts. Hepatic and renal dropsies; chronic alcoholics. Incipient and progressive cataracts.
One of the remedies whose symptoms point to its employment in bladder affections, notably catarrh, acute and chronic. *Scanty urine, and loaded with ropy, muco-purulent sediment. Prostatic enlargement*.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Pain in left frontal protuberance. Halo about the light. Itching of eyelids. Stabbing pain in left eye with lachrymation.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Toothache, worse after eating and exertion, better cool water. Pain as if tooth was being gently pulled.

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: Urging to urinate. Urine turbid, offensive, containing ropy or bloody mucus, and depositing a copious sediment. Burning and scalding during micturition, and straining afterwards. *Must strain* before flow comes. Scanty urine. Acute prostatitis, retention, and *feeling of a ball in perineum* (*Cann ind*). Fluttering in region of kidney. *Sugar in urine*. Unable to urinate without standing with feet wide apart and body inclined forward.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Labia inflamed, swollen. Pain in vagina. Hot flashes. Painful *tumor of mammae*, not ulcerated, with undue secretion of milk. Rapid atrophy of breasts. Women with *very large breasts* and tumor in the mammary gland with *sharp* pain through it.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Smarting in urethra from neck of bladder to meatus. Gleet. Loss of prostatic fluid. Prostatic enlargement and irritation.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Scrofulous ulcers. Glandular enlargements.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Feeling of a band above left knee.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, in damp weather; from sitting on cold stones or pavements; left side.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Chimaph maculata* (intense gnawing hunger; burning fever; sensation of swelling in arm pits); *Uva; Ledum; Epigoea*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture, to third attenuation.

remedies.heading: CHINA OFFICINALIS
remedies.intro: *Debility* from exhausting discharges, from loss of vital fluids, together with a *nervous erethism*, calls for this remedy. Periodicity is most marked. Sensitive to draughts. Seldom indicated in the earlier stages of acute disease. Chronic gout. Chronic suppurative pyelitis. Post operative gas pains, not relief from passing it.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Apathetic, indifferent, disobedient, taciturn, despondent. Ideas crowd in mind; prevent sleep. Disposition to hurt other people's feelings. Sudden crying and tossing about.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: As if skull would burst. Sensation as if brain were balancing to and fro, and striking against skull, receiving great pain (*Sulph; Sulph ac*). Intense *throbbing* of head and carotids. Spasmodic headache in vertex, with subsequent pain, as if bruised in sides of head. Face flushed after haemorrhages, or sexual excesses, or loss of vital fluids. Relieved from pressure and warm room. Scalp sensitive; worse combing hair. Aches worse in open air, from temple to temple. Worse by contact, current of air, stepping. Dizzy when walking.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Blue color around eyes. Hollow eyes. Yellowish sclerotica. Black specks, bright dazzling illusions; night blindness in anaemic retina. Spots before eyes. Photophobia. Distortion of eyeballs. Intermittent ciliary neuralgia. *Pressure in eyes*. Amaurosis; scalding lachrymation.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: *Ringing* in ears. External ear sensitive to touch. Hearing sensitive to noise. Lobules red and swollen.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Checked catarrh. Easily bleeding from nose, especially on rising. Coryza, sneezing, watery discharge. Violent *dry* sneezing. Cold sweat about nose.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Sallow complexion. Face bloated; red.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Toothache; better pressing teeth firmly together, and by warmth. Tongue coated thick, dirty; tip burns, succeeded by ptyalism. Bitter taste. Food tastes too salty.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Tender, cold. Vomiting of undigested food. Slow digestion. Weight after eating. Ill effects of tea. Hungry without appetite. Flat taste. Darting pain crosswise in hypogastric region. Milk disagrees. Hungry longing for food, which lies undigested. *Flatulence; belching* of bitter fluid or regurgitation of food *gives no relief*; worse eating fruit. *Hiccough*. Bloatedness better by movement.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Much flatulent colic; better bending double. *Tympanitic abdomen*. Pain in right hypochondrium. *Gall-stone colic* (*Triumfetta semitriloba*). Liver and spleen swollen and enlarged. Jaundice. Internal coldness of stomach and abdomen. Gastro-duodenal catarrh.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Undigested, frothy, yellow; *painless*; worse at night, after meals, during hot weather, from *fruit*, milk, beer. Very weakening, with much flatulence. Difficult even when soft (*Alum; Plat*).

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Excited lascivious fancy. Frequent emissions, followed by great weakness. Orchitis.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses too early. *Dark clots and abdominal distention*. Profuse menses with pain. Desire too strong. Bloody leucorrhoea. Seems to take the place of the usual menstrual discharge. Painful heaviness in pelvis.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Influenza, with debility. Cannot breathe with head low. Labored, slow respiration; constant choking. *Suffocative catarrh; rattling in chest*; violent, hacking cough *after every meal*. Haemorrhage from lungs. Dyspnoea, sharp pain in left lung. Asthma; worse damp weather.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Irregular with weak rapid beats followed by strong, hard beats. Suffocative attacks, syncope; anaemia and dropsy.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Sharp pains across kidneys, worse movement and at night. Knife-like pains around back (D. MacFarlan).

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: *Pains in limbs and joints*, as if sprained; *worse, slight touch*; hard pressure relieves. Sensation as of a string around limb. Joints swollen; very sensitive, with dread or open air. Great debility, trembling, with numb sensation. Averse to exercise; sensitive to touch. Weariness of joints; worse, mornings and when sitting.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: *Extreme sensitiveness to touch*, but hard pressure *relieves. Coldness*; much sweat. One hand ice cold, the other warm. Anasarca (*Ars; Apis*). *Dermatitis*; erysipelas. Indurated glands; scrofulous ulcers and caries.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Drowsiness. Unrefreshing or constant stupor. Wakens early. Protracted sleeplessness. Anxious, frightful dreams with confused consciousness on waking, so that the dream cannot be rid of and fear of dream remains. Snoring, especially with children.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Intermittent, paroxysms anticipate; return every week. All stages well marked. Chill generally in forenoon, commencing in breast; thirst before chill, and little and often. Debilitating night-sweats. Free perspiration caused by every little exertion, especially on single parts. Hay fever, watery coryza, pain in temples.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse, slightest touch*. Draught of air; every other day; loss of vital fluids; at night; *after eating*; bending over. *Better*, bending double; hard pressure; open air; warmth.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidotes: *Arn; Ars; Nux; Ipec*.
Compare:-*Quinidin*--(Paroxysmal tachycardia and *auricular fibrillation*. Heart is slowed, and the auriculo-ventricular conduction time is lengthened. Dose 1/2 grain t.i.d). *Cephalanthus*--(Button Bush-Intermittent fever, sore throat, rheumatic symptoms, vivid dreams). *Ars; Cedron; Nat sulph. Cydonia vulgaris*-Quince (supposed to be of use to strengthen the sexual organs and stomach).
Complementary: *Ferrum; Calc phos*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture, to thirtieth potency.

remedies.heading: CHININUM ARSENICOSUM
remedies.intro: The symptoms of general *weariness and prostration* produced by the drug have been utilized in prescribing it homeopathically as a general tonic, often with very marked beneficial and prompt effect. In diphtheria with great prostration, cases that are prolonged, especially, and in malarial affections, neuralgia, etc, it has been found curative. Asthmatic attacks which recur periodically, with great prostration. Icy skin. Pressure in the solar plexus, with tender spine back of it.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Tired feeling. Head feels too full. Throbbing. Great anxiety. Great irritability. Vertigo; worse looking up. Dull, heavy headache, frontal and occipital. Darting pains running up into head.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Intense photophobia and orbicular spasm; gushing hot tears. Flickering with pain and lachrymation.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Tongue thickly furred; yellow, slimy coating. Bitter taste. No appetite.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Alternation of hyperacidity and decrease of acid. Hyperchlorhydria (*Robinia; Arg nit; Orexine tannate*). Thirst for water, yet it disturbs. *Anorexia. Eggs produce diarrhoea*.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Palpitation. Sensation as if heart stopped. Suffocative attacks, occurring in periodical paroxysms. Must have open air. Short of breath on ascending; cardiac dyspnoea; circulatory weakness after acute infections; early myocardial degeneration.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Sleeplessness due to nervous causes (Single dose of 5th or 6th potency).

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Weak limbs. *Coldness of hands and feet, knees and limbs*. Tearing pains.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Continuous, with weakness. System depleted.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Chininum*; also *Ferrum Citricum* (in nephritis with great anaemia; acid dyspepsia in chlorosis. Morbus maculosus Werlhoffii); *Chinin mur* (in severe neuralgic pains around eyes, with chills; exaggerated sensitiveness to alcohol and tobacco; prostration and restlessness). *OEnothera* (effortless diarrhoea with nervous exhaustion; incipient hydrocephaloid). *Macrozamia spiralis* (extreme debility after illness; collapse).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Second and third trituration.

remedies.heading: CHININUM SULPHURICUM
remedies.intro: A dose of Chinin sulph in high potency sometimes arouses suppressed malaria, and brings back the paroxysm. Aside from its undoubted influence over malaria, it is indicated homeopathically whenever there is marked periodicity and spinal sensitiveness. *Acute articular rheumatism*. Polyarticular gout. Pruritus and congested conditions of the rectum. Symptoms of *chronic interstitial nephritis*. Retro-bulbar neuritis with sudden loss of sight. Thready vessels. Hiccough.

sections.heading: Blood
sections.text: An immediate and rapid decrease in red blood cells and reduction in hemoglobin with increase in elimination of chlorides. Tendency to polynucleated leucocytosis.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Pain in forehead and temples, increasing gradually at noon, of malarial origin, with vertigo and pulsation. Worse left side. Falling in street. Inability to remain standing. Amaurosis.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Violent ringing, buzzing, *and roaring in ears, with deafness*.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Neuralgia commences under eye; extends into and around it. Pains return with great regularity; *relieved by pressure*.

sections.heading: Spine
sections.text: *Great sensitiveness of the dorsal vertebrae*; pain on pressure. Last cervical sensitive. Pain extends to head and neck.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Bloody. Turbid, slimy, clay-colored, greasy sediment. Small amount of urea and phosphoric acid with excess of uric acid and abundance of chlorides, accompanied by subnormal temperature. Excessive flow. Albuminuria

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Itching; erythema, urticaria, icterus, vesication, pustules, purpura. Great sensitiveness. Shriveled skin.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Chill daily at 3 pm. Painful swelling of various veins during a chill. Shivering even in a warm room. Anguish. Subnormal temperature.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: *Chin salicyl* (Deafness, tinnitus, and Meniere's disease). *Ars; Eupat; Methyl blue. Camphor mono-bromide* (is said to intensify the action of Quinine and render it more permanent). *Baja*, an East Indian drug, (said to be almost infallible in intermittent fever, quartan type; pulsating headache injected eyes, flushed face. Liver and spleen enlarged. OEdema). Also *Pambotano*, Mexican remedy for intermittent and tropical fevers.
Antidotes: *Parthenum; Natr mur; Lach; Arn; Puls*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to third triturations; also thirtieth potency and higher.

remedies.heading: CHIONANTHUS VIRGINICA
remedies.intro:
This remedy is often of service in many types of headaches, neurasthenic,
*periodical sick*, menstrual and bilious. Taken for several weeks, drop doses, will often break up the sick headache habit. The pain in the forehead, chiefly over eyes. Eyeballs very painful, with pressure over root of nose. Hepatic derangements. *Jaundice*. Enlarged spleen (*Ceanoth*). Jaundice with arrest of menses. A prominent liver remedy. *Gallstones* (*Berberis; Cholest; Calc*). *Diabetes mellitus*. Paroxysmal, abdominal pain.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Listless, apathetic. Dull frontal headache, over root of nose, over eyes, through temples, worse stooping, motion, jar. *Yellow conjunctiva*.

sections.heading: Tongue
sections.text: Broad with thick yellow fur.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Dry sensation not relieved by water, also profuse saliva.

sections.heading: Abdomen and Liver
sections.text: Aching in umbilical region, griping. Feels as if a string were tied in a "slip-knot" around intestines which was suddenly drawn tight and then gradually loosened. *Sore; enlarged, with jaundice* and constipation. Clay-colored stool, also soft, yellow and pasty. Tongue heavily coated. No appetite. Bilious colic. Hepatic region tender. Pancreatic disease and other glandular disorders.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Large amount of high specific gravity; frequent urination; bile and sugar in urine. Urine very dark.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Yellow; marked moisture of skin. Sallow, greenish, itching.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Cinchona; Ceanoth; Chelidon; Carduus; Podophyl; Lept*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture and first attenuation.

remedies.heading: CHLORALUM HYDRATUM
remedies.intro: This drug, used in physiological doses, is a powerful hypnotic and cardiac depressant. It has a marked effect on the skin, producing erythema, ecchymosis, etc, which symptoms have been utilized homeopathically with much success, especially in the treatment of hives. Emotional excitability, hallucinations. Night terrors in children. Muscular prostration.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Morning headache; worse in forehead, also in occiput, on motion; better in open air. Passive cerebral hyperaemia (use 30th). Feeling as if hot band were drawn from temple to temple. Hears voices.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Eyes blood-shot and watery. Circles of light, black spots. Illusions of sight where eyes are closed or at night. Dim vision. Conjunctivitis, burning in eye and lids; eyeball feels too large; everything looks *white*.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Red blotches, like measles. *Urticaria, worse, spirituous liquors, hot drinks*. Erythema aggravated by alcoholic drinks, with palpitation; causes pain in tendons and extensors. Intense itching. Surface of body *stone-cold*. Wheals come on from a chill; better, warmth. Purpura (*Phos; Crotal*).

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Extreme dyspnoea, with sensation of weight and constriction of chest. Asthma, with sleeplessness.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Insomnia, hallucinations, horrid dreams. Somnolence.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, after hot drinks, stimulants, eating, night.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidotes: *Ammon; Atrop; Dig; Mosch*.
Compare: *Bell; Opium; Apis; Veronal*--(a dangerous drug made by the action of alcohol upon urea and contains the same radical that alcohol does. Makes a man just as drunk as pure alcohol. Staggers, cannot stand up) (Dr. Varney). (Confluent reddish spots; dermatitis, itching of glans and prepuce; circumscribed dermatitis patch on first metacarpal phalangeal joint). *Luminal*--(Sleeplessness with skin symptoms in migraine; lethargy like epidemic encephalitis) (Dr. Royal).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First trituration in hives, otherwise, higher potencies. Locally, in offensive foot-sweat, bathe with one per cent solution. For its physiological effects, five to twenty grains. Use cautiously.

remedies.heading: CHLOROFORMIUM
remedies.intro:
General anaesthetic, antispasmodic. Complete muscular relaxation. Weak and quick pulse, shallow or stertorous breathing. Convulsions, nephritic or biliary colic, gastralgia.
Symptoms obtained by Dr. D. Macfarlan with the 6th potency.
Great weakness, especially on right side. Limbs very tired from knees down. Much perspiration all over face and chest; drowsy and dizzy; dry lips and throat; dry tickling cough at night. Flatulence; food regurgitates; sore and bruised feeling in stomach; catching pain around heart. Sharp pain in right chest when he takes long breath; shortness of breath on exertion.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Delirium where excitement and violence predominate. Head drawn down upon the shoulders, eyes opened and closed rapidly, pupils contracted; rapid convulsive movements of face, of muscles, of extremities.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: *Ether* Post-operative Bronchitis (Prof. Bier). *Spiritus Aetheris Compositus*.--(Hoffman's Anodyne)--(Flatulence; angina pectoris. Dose 5m to 1 dram in water).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Higher attenuations, or sixth. *Phosphorus* is the remedy to give in narcosis of chloroform.

remedies.heading: CHLORUM
remedies.intro: The marked effect on the respiratory organs, producing spasm of the glottis, is the chief symptom of the drug. Asthma to relieve the spasm of glottis. Useful externally and internally in gangrene.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Fear of becoming crazy. Marked loss of memory, *especially for names*.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Sooty, smoky nostrils. Coryza with sudden gushes of sharp, corroding fluid, making nose sore inside and about the alae. *Constriction, with suffocation. Spasm of the glottis*. Irritation of epiglottis, larynx, and bronchi. Loss of voice from damp air. *Sudden dyspnoea from spasm of the vocal cords*, with staring protruding eyes, blue face, cold sweat, pulse small. *Inspiration free, with obstructed expiration.* (*Mephit*). Livid face. Prolonged, loud, whistling rales. Extreme dryness of tongue.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Chlorine water, when required of full strength, must be freshly prepared. Fourth to sixth potency.

remedies.heading: CHOLESTERINUM
remedies.commonName: Cholesterine--The proximate principle--Furnished by the epithelium lining of gall bladder and the larger ducts
remedies.intro: For cancer of the liver. *Obstinate hepatic engorgements*. Burning pain in side; on walking holds his hand on side, hurts him so. Opacities of the vitreous. Jaundice; gallstones. Cholesterine is the physiological opponent of Lecithin. Both seem to play some unknown part in the growth of tumors. Gallstones and insomnia.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Taurocholate of soda* in Homeopathy.--Dr. I. P. Tessier, in an interesting study of the action of bile and its salts, in hepatic affections, analyzes a number of experiments by leading authorities, with the object of determining this action, and concludes that in the *Taurocholate of Soda*, homeopathy has a useful remedy against certain forms of hypoglobular anaemia. The claim that its pathogenesis and toxicology clearly indicate its value, and that it should also serve us as a remedy in cases of hypertrophy of the spleen and ganglia. He calls our attention to the fact, that it produces dyspnoea, the Cheyne-Stokes rhythm, acute pulmonary oedema, and intense exaggeration of the cardiac pulsations, offering a good field for clinical studies and experimentation of great interest, which may give fruitful and important results.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third trituration.

remedies.heading: CHROMICUM ACIDUM
remedies.intro: Diphtheria, post-nasal tumors, and epithelioma of the tongue have been benefited by this drug. Bloody, foul-smelling lochia. Symptoms come and go *suddenly*, and return periodically; offensive discharges.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Ulcer and scabs in nose. Offensive smell. Corrosive pain. Ozaena (*Aur*).

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Diphtheria; sore throat. Tough mucus, with inclination to swallow it; worse, causing hawking. Post-nasal tumors.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Uneasiness in limbs. Pain in shoulder-blades and back of neck. Pain in knees and balls of feet. Drawing pain in soles while walking.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Watery, frequent, copious, with nausea and vertigo. Haemorrhoids, internal and bleeding. Weakness in small of back.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Kali bich; Rhus; Chromium Sulphate* (in locomotor ataxia, goitre, *prostatic hypertrophy*. Herpes preputialis. Wry neck. Also exophthalmic, inhibits the vagus, relieving tachycardia. Acts like a nerve tonic where there is lack of nervous tone. Fibroid tumors. Infantile paralysis. Dose for adults, 3 to 5 grains after meals and at bedtime).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Homeopathically, third to sixth trituration.

remedies.heading: CHRYSAROBINUM
remedies.intro: Acts as a powerful irritant of the skin and used successfully in skin diseases especially in *ringworm, psoriasis*, herpes tonsurans acne rosacea. Vesicular or squamous lesions, associated with foul smelling discharge and crust formation, tending to become confluent and to give the appearance of a single crust covering the entire area (Bernstein). *Violent itching*, thighs, legs and *ears*. Dry, scaly eruption, especially around eyes and ears, scabs with pus underneath (*Mezer*).

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Blepharitis, conjunctivitis keratitis. Intense photophobia. Optical hyperaesthesia.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Eczema behind ears. Filthy, scabby condition with tendency to form thick crust. Whole ear and surrounding tissue appears to be one scab.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Chrysarobinum contains chrysophan, which is rapidly oxidized into chrysophanic acid. This is also contained in Rhubarb and Senna.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Locally, as a cerate, 4-8 grains to the ounce, of vaseline. Internally, third to sixth potency. Used externally; should be used with caution on account of its ability to produce inflammation.

remedies.heading: CICUTA VIROSA
remedies.intro: The action on the nervous system, producing spasmodic affections, viz, hiccough, trismus, tetanus, and convulsions, give the pathological picture calling especially for this remedy, whenever this is further characterized, by the more individual symptoms of the drug. Among these, are the *bending of the head, neck, and spine backwards*, and the general action of the patient is *violent*, with frightful distortions. Violent, strange desires. Sensation of internal chill. Moaning and howling. Does absurd things. Marked action on the skin.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Delirium, with singing, dancing and funny gestures. Everything appears strange and terrible. Confounds present with the past; feels like a child. Stupid feeling. Melancholy, with indifference. Mistrustful. Epilepsy; moaning and whining. Vivid dreams.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: *Head turned or twisted to one side. Cerebro-spinal meningitis. Cervical muscles contracted*. Vertigo, with gastralgia, and muscular spasms. Sudden, violent shocks through head. Stares persistently at objects. *Convulsions* from concussion of brain. Thick, yellow scabs on head. Head symptoms relieved by emission of flatus.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: When reading, letters disappear. *Pupils dilated, insensible strabismus*. Objects recede, approach, and seem double. Eyes stare. Pupils get behind upper lids as head inclines. Effects of exposure to snow. Spasmodic affections of eyes and its appendages. Strabismus; periodic, spasmodic after a fall or a blow.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Difficult hearing. Sudden detonations especially on swallowing. *Haemorrhage from ears*.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Pustules which run together forming thick, yellow scabs on face and head, corners of mouth and chin, with burning pain. *Red face*. Trismus; disposition to grind teeth.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Dry. Feels as if grown together. Spasms of oesophagus; cannot swallow. Effects on oesophagus from swallowing sharp piece of bone.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Thirst; burning pressure; *hiccough*. Throbbing in pit of stomach, which has become raised to size of fist. Desire for unnatural things, *like coal* (*Alum; Calc*). Indigestion, with insensibility, frothing at mouth.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Flatulence with anxiety and crossness. Rumbling in. Distended and painful. Colic with convulsions.

sections.heading: Rectum
sections.text: Diarrhoea in morning, with irresistible desire to urinate. Itching in rectum.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Chest feels tight; can hardly breathe. Tonic spasm in pectoral muscles. Heat in chest.

sections.heading: Back and extremities
sections.text: Spasms and cramps in muscles of nape of neck, and spasmodic drawing backward of head. Curved limbs cannot be straightened nor straight ones bent. *Back bent backward like an arch*. Jerking, tearing in coccyx, especially during menses.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Eczema; no itching, exudation forms into a *hard, lemon-colored crust*. Suppressed eruption causes brain disease. Elevated eruptions, as large as peas. Chronic impetigo.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, from touch, draughts, concussion, tobacco smoke.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidotes: *Opium; Arn*.
Compare: *Cicuta Maculata*-Water Hemlock--(Effects very similar; the most prominent symptoms being; Falls unconscious, tetanic or clonic convulsions. Body covered with sweat. Consider in epilepsy and tetanus. Tincture and lower potencies). *Hydrocy acid; Con; Oenanth; Strychnia; Bellad*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Sixth to two hundredth attenuation.

remedies.heading: CIMEX LECTULARIUS
remedies.intro: Of use in intermittent fever, with weariness and inclination to stretch. Hamstrings feel too short (*Ammon mur*). Flexors mostly affected. Sensation of retraction of arm tendons. Stretching.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Violent headache, caused by drinking. Great rage; vehement at beginning of chilly stage. Would like to tear everything to pieces. Pain under right frontal bone.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Shooting pain from vagina up towards left ovary.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Chilliness of whole body. Sensation as of wind blowing on knees. *Pains in all joints, as if tendons were too short*, especially knee-joints. Chill; worse lying down. Thirst during apyrexia, but little during chilly stage; still less during hot stage, and none during sweating. Musty, offensive sweat.

sections.heading: Bowels
sections.text: Constipation, feces dry and in small balls (*Op; Plumb; Thuj*) and hard. Ulcer of rectum.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Sixth to two hundredth attenuation.

remedies.heading: CIMICIFUGA RACEMOSA
remedies.intro: Has a wide action upon the cerebrospinal and muscular system, as well as upon the uterus and ovaries. Especially useful in rheumatic, nervous subjects with ovarian irritation, uterine cramps and heavy limbs. Its muscular and crampy pains, primarily of neurotic origin, occurring in nearly every part of the body, are characteristic. *Agitation and pain* indicate it. Pains like electric shocks here and there. Migraine. Symptoms referable to the pelvic organs prominent. "It lessens the frequency and force of the pulse soothes pain and allays irritability".

sections.heading: Mental
sections.text: Sensation of a cloud enveloping her. Great depression, with *dream of impending evil*. Fears riding in a closed carriage, of being obliged to jump out. Incessant talking. Visions of rats, mice, etc. Delirium tremens; tries to injure himself. Mania following disappearance of neuralgia.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Wild feeling in brain. Shooting and throbbing pains in head after mental worry, over-study, or reflex of uterine disease. Waving sensation or *opening and shutting sensation in brain*. Brain feels too large. *Pressing-outward* pain. Tinnitus. Ears sensitive to least noise.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Asthenopia associated with pelvic trouble. Deepseated throbbing and *shooting pains* in eyes, with photophobia from artificial light. *Intense aching of eyeball. Pain from eyes to top of head*.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Nausea and vomiting caused by pressure on spine and cervical region. Sinking in epigastrium (*Sep; Sulph*). *Gnawing pain*. Tongue pointed and trembling.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Amenorrhoea (use Macrotin preferably). Pain in ovarian region; shoots upward and down anterior surface of thighs. Pain immediately before menses. Menses profuse, dark, *coagulated*, offensive with backache, nervousness; always irregular. Ovarian neuralgia. *Pain across pelvis, from hip to hip*. After-pains, with great sensitiveness and *intolerance to pain*. Infra-mammary pains worse, left side. Facial blemishes in young women.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Tickling in throat. Dry, short cough, *worse speaking* and at night. Cough when secretion is scanty-spasmodic, dry with muscular soreness and nervous irritation.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Irregular, slow, trembling pulse. Tremulous action. Angina pectoris. Numbness of left arm; feels as if bound to side. Heart's action ceases suddenly, impending suffocation. Left-sided infra-mammary pain.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Spine very sensitive, especially upper part. *Stiffness and contraction in neck and back*. Intercostal rheumatism. Rheumatic pains in muscles of back and neck. Pain in lumbar and sacral region, down thighs, and through hips. Crick in back.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Uneasy, restless feeling in limbs. Aching in limbs and *muscular soreness*. Rheumatism affecting the belly of muscles, especially large muscles. Choreic movements, accompanied by rheumatism. Jerking of limbs. Stiffness in tendo-Achilles. Heaviness in lower extremities. Heavy, aching, tensive pain.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Sleeplessness. Brain irritation of children during dentition.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Locally and internally for ivy poisoning.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, morning, cold (except headache), during menses; the more profuse the flow, the greater the suffering. *Better*, warmth, eating.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Rhamnus Californica* (*muscular pains*, lumbago, pleurodynia, acute rheumatism). *Derris pinnata* (Neuralgic headaches of rheumatic origin). *Aristolochia milhomens* (pain in tendo-Achilles; diabetes). *Caulophyl; Pulsat; Lilium; Agar; Macrotin* (especially for lumbago).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to thirtieth attenuation, third most frequently used.

remedies.heading: CINA MARITIMA
remedies.intro:
This is a children's remedy,-big, fat, rosy, scrofulous, corresponding to many conditions that may be referred to intestinal irritation, such as worms and accompanying complaints. An irritability of temper, variable appetite, grinding of teeth, and even convulsions, with screams and violent jerkings of the hands and feet, are all within its range of action. The Cina patient is hungry, cross, ugly, and wants to be rocked.
*Pain in shocks*. Skin sensitive to touch.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Ill-humor. Child *very cross*; does not want to be touched, or crossed, or carried. Desires many things, but rejects everything offered. Abnormal consciousness, as if having committed some evil deed.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Headache, alternating with pain in abdomen. Relieved by stooping (*Mezer*). Pain in head when using eyes.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Dilated pupils; yellow vision. Weak sight from masturbation. Strabismus from abdominal irritation. Eyestrain, especially when presbyopia sets in. *Pulsation of superciliary muscle*.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Digging and scratching in ears.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Itching of nose all the time. *Wants to rub* it and pick at it. *Bores at nose* till it bleeds.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Intense, circumscribed redness of cheeks. *Pale*, hot, *with dark rings around eyes*. Cold perspiration. *White and bluish about the mouth*. Grits teeth during sleep. *Choreic movements of face* and hands.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Gets hungry soon after a meal. *Hungry*, digging, gnawing sensation. Epigastric pain; worse, first waking in morning and before meals. Vomiting and diarrhoea immediately after eating or drinking. Vomiting with a clean tongue. Desires many and different things. Craving for sweets.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: *Twisting pain about navel* (*Spig*). Bloated and hard abdomen.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: White mucus, like small pieces of popped corn, preceded by pinching colic. *Itching of anus* (*Teuc*). Worms (*Sabad; Naphth; Nat phos*).

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Turbid, white; turns milky on standing. Involuntary at night.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Uterine haemorrhage before puberty.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Gagging cough in the morning. Whooping-cough. Violent recurring paroxysms, as of down in throat. Cough ends in a spasm. Cough so violent as to bring tears and sternal pains; feels as if something had been torn off. Periodic; returning spring and fall. Swallows after coughing. *Gurgling from throat to stomach after coughing*. Child is afraid to speak or move for fear of bringing on paroxysm of coughing. After coughing, moaning, anxious, gasps for air and turns pale.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: *Twitching* and jerking distortion of limbs, trembling. Paralyzed shocks; patient will jump suddenly, as though in pain. Child throws arms from side to side. Nocturnal convulsions. *Sudden inward jerking of fingers of right hand. Child stretches out feet spasmodically*. Left foot in constant spasmodic motion.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Child gets on hands and knees in sleep; on abdomen. Night terrors of children; cries out, screams, wakes frightened. *Troubles while yawning*. Screams and talks in sleep. Grits teeth.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Light chill. Much fever, associated with clean tongue. Much hunger; colicky pains; chilliness, with thirst. Cold sweat on forehead, nose, and hands. In Cina fever, face is cold and hands warm.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, looking fixedly at an object, from worms, at night, in sun, in summer.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: *Santonin*--(often preferable in worm affections; same symptoms as Cina; corresponding to the "pain in shocks" produced by Cina. Visual illusions, *yellow* sight; violet light not recognized, colors not distinguishable. Urine deep saffron color. Spasms and twitchings, chronic gastric and intestinal troubles sometimes removed by a single dose (physiological) of Santonin. Dahlke). *Helmintochortos*-Worm-moss (acts very powerfully on intestinal worms, especially the lumbricoid). *Teucrium; Ignat; Cham; Spig*.
Antidote: *Camph; Caps*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third attenuation. For nervous irritable children, thirtieth and two-hundredth preferable. Santonin in first (with care) and third trituration.

remedies.heading: CINERARIA MARITIMA
remedies.intro: Has some reputation in the cure of cataract and corneal opacities. Is used externally, by instilling into the eye one drop four or five times a day. This must be kept up for several months. Most effective in traumatic cases. Compare in cataract *Phosph; Platanus; Cannabis; Causticum; Naphthalin; Ledum; Nat mur; Silica*.

remedies.heading: CINNABARIS
remedies.intro: For certain forms of ciliary neuralgia and ulceration upon a syphilitic base, this remedy is most effective. Sleepless during night.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Congestion to head; face purple red.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: *Pains from lachrymal duct around eye to temple, from inner canthus across brows to ear. Severe shooting pain in bones of orbit, especially running from inner to outer canthus in the bone. Redness of whole eye*. Lids granulated; canthi and lids red.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Pressive sensation, as from heavy spectacles. Pain about root, extending into bones on each side (*Aur; Kal hyd*).

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Stringy mucus passed through posterior nares into throat. Dryness of mouth and throat; must rinse the mouth. Fiery-looking ulcers in mouth and throat.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Prepuce swollen; *warts* on it which bleed easily; testicles enlarged; buboes; angry-looking chancres. Syphilides, squamous and vesicular.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Leucorrhoea. Feeling of pressure in vagina.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Pain in forearm from elbow down, including hands. Pain in long bones when barometer lowers; coldness of joints.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: *Very fiery-red* looking ulcers. Nodes on shin-bones. Buboes. Condyloma, easily bleeding.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, lying on right side (feels as if contents of body were being dragged over to that side).

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: *Hepar; Nitr ac; Thuja; Sep*.
Antidotes: *Hepar; Sulph*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to third trituration.

remedies.heading: CINNAMOMUM CEYLANICUM
remedies.intro: Cancer where pain and fetor are present. Best when skin is intact. Its use in haemorrhages has abundant clinical verification. Nosebleed. Haemorrhages from bowels, haemoptysis, etc. A strain in loins or false step brings on a profuse flow of bright blood. *Post-partum haemorrhage*. Flatulency and diarrhoea. Feeble patients with languid circulation.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Bearing-down sensation. Menses *early, profuse, prolonged, bright red*. Sleepy. No desire for anything. Fingers seem swollen. Uterine haemorrhages caused by overlifting, during puerperal state; menorrhagia.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: *Ipec; Sil; Trill*.
Antidote: Acon.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture to third potency. For cancer, strong decoction, one-half pint in a day. *Oil of cinnamon* in aqueous solution best local disinfectant. 3-4 drops in two quarts of water as a douche, wherever a germicide and disinfectant is needed. Three drops on sugar for hiccough.

remedies.heading: CISTUS CANADENSIS
remedies.intro: A deep-acting anti-psoric remedy, with marked action in glandular affections, herpetic eruptions, chronic swellings, when patient *is extremely sensitive to cold. Sensation of coldness in various parts*. Scrofulous ophthalmia. Poisoned wounds, bites, phagedenic ulcers. *Malignant disease of the glands of the neck*. Cistus has affinity for naso-pharynx; aborts colds that center in posterior nose. Sniffling.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Itching, burning, and crusts on right zygoma. Lupus, caries; open, bleeding cancer. Tip of nose painful.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Scorbutic swollen gums. *Mouth feels cold*; putrid, impure breath. *Pyorrhea* (*Merc cor; Caust; Staph; Kreos*). *Hurts to protrude the tongue*.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Watery discharge; also fetid pus. Tetter on and around ears, extending to external meatus.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Spongy feeling; *very dry* and *cold air passing over parts causes pain*. Breath, tongue, and throat feel cold. Uvula and tonsils swollen. A small, dry spot in throat; must sip water frequently. Hawking of mucus. Swelling and suppuration of glands of throat. Head drawn to one side by swellings in neck. Sore throat from inhaling the least *cold air*. Heat and itching in throat.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: *Cool feeling* in stomach before and after eating. *Cool feeling* in whole abdomen. Desire for cheese.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Diarrhoea from coffee and fruit, thin, yellow, urgent; worse in morning.

sections.heading: Chest
sections.text: Coldness in chest. The neck is studded with tumors. Induration of mammae. Haemorrhage from lungs.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Sprained pain in wrist. Tips of fingers sensitive to cold. Tetter on hands. Cold feet. Syphilitic ulcers on lower limbs, with hard swelling around. White swelling.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Cannot sleep from coldness in throat.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Induration and inflammation of mammae. Sensitive to cold air. Bad smelling leucorrhoea.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Asthmatic after lying down (trachea feels narrow), preceded by formication.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Itching all over. Small, painful pimples; lupus. *Glands inflamed and indurated*. Mercurio-syphilitic ulcers. Skin of hands hard, thick, dry, fissured; deep cracks. Itching of swollen hands and arms; general itching which presents sleep. Hemicrania.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, slightest exposure to cold air; mental exertion, excitement. *Better* after eating.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidotes: *Rhus; Sepia*.
Compare: *Conium; Carbo; Calc; Arg n*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to thirtieth attenuation. Locally as a wash to arrest fetid discharges.

remedies.heading: CITRUS VULGARIS
remedies.intro: Headache with nausea, vomiting and vertigo. Facial neuralgias mostly right-sided. Thoracic oppression. Frequent and irresistible yawning. Disturbed sleep.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: *Citrus decumana*-Grape-fruit (Tinnitus, *head noises* and ringing in ears. Sensation of pressure in the temporal region). *Aurantium*-Orange (neuralgic and skin symptoms. Itching, redness and swelling of hands. Diseases of the aged with coldness and chilliness. Boiled dried *orange peel* excites the intestine in a manner similar to other forms of cellulose or agar. There is an increased flow of bile which continues for hours. It unites both a cholagogue action with a mechanical stimulus to peristalsis). Compare: *Citrus Limonum* (scorbutus, sore throat and cancer pains; checks excessive menstruation). (*Citric Acid*.--Useful in *scurvy* and chronic rheumatism and haemorrhages. All forms of *Dropsy* are benefited with Citric acid and lemon juice, tablespoonful every 3-4 hours. Pain from cancer of tongue. Used as a local application and mouth wash, one dram to 8 ozs of water. For cancer pains generally, often effective).

remedies.heading: CLEMATIS ERECTA
remedies.intro: Scrofulous, rheumatic, gonorrhoeal, and syphilitic patients. Acts especially on skin, *glands* and genito-urinary organs, especially testicles. A remedy of much importance in disturbances of sleep, and neuralgic *pains* in various parts. Many of these pains are relieved by perspiration. Muscles relaxed or twitching. Great emaciation. *Great sleepiness*. Distant pulsation in whole body.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Boring pain in temples. *Confused feeling; better in open air*. Eruption on occiput at base of hair, moist, pustular sensitive, itching.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Heat in eyes and *sensitive to air*; must close them. Chronic blepharitis, with sore and swollen meibomain glands. Iritis, great *sensitiveness to cold*. Flickering before eyes. Pustular conjunctivitis, with tinea capitis; eyes inflamed and protruding.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: White blisters on face and nose, as if burned by sun. Swelling of submaxillary glands, with hard tubercles, throbbing, aggravated on being touched. Pain in right side of face to eye, ear and temple; better, holding cold water in mouth.

sections.heading: Teeth
sections.text: *Ache; worse, at night and from tobacco*. Teeth feel too long.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: After eating, weakness in all limbs and pulsation in arteries.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Ilio-scrotal neuralgia. *Testicles indurated with bruised feeling*. Swelling of scrotum (*Orchitis*). Right half only. Troubles from suppressed gonorrhoea. Violent erections with stitches in urethra. Testicles hang heavy or retracted, with pain along spermatic cord; worse, right side.

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: Tingling in urethra lasting some time after urinating. Frequent, scanty urination; burning at orifice. *Interrupted flow*. Urethra feels constricted. Urine emitted drop by drop. Inability to pass all the urine; dribbling after urinating. Pain worse at night, pain along the spermatic cord. Commencing stricture.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Red, burning, vesicular, scaly, scabby. Itches terribly; worse, washing in cold water; worse face and hands and *scalp around occiput. Glands* hot, painful, *swollen*; worse inguinal glands. Glandular indurations and tumors of breast. Varicose ulcers.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Better*, in open air. *Worse*, at night, and warmth of bed (washing in cold water); new moon--(monthly aggravation).

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: *Clematis vitalba* (varicose and other ulcers); *Sil; Staph; Petrol; Oleand; Sarsap; Canth; Phos ac; Pulsat*.
Antidotes: *Bryon; Camph*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.heading: COBALTUM METALLICUM
remedies.intro: Adapted to neurasthenic spinal states. Sexual disturbances. Fatigue, agitation, and bone pains, worse in morning.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: All mental excitement increases suffering. Constant interchange of mental moods.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Aches; worse, bending head *forward*. Itching of hairy scalp and beard.

sections.heading: Teeth
sections.text: Feel too long. Pain in teeth. Cracks across tongue. Coated white (*Ant cr*).

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Shooting in liver. Pain in spleen.

sections.heading: Rectum
sections.text: Constant dropping of blood from the anus, no blood from the stools.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Pain in right testicle; better, urinating. *Emissions* without erection. Impotence. Backache in lumbar region and weak legs. Lewd dreams. Pain in end of urethra; greenish discharge; brown spots on genitals and abdomen.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: *Pain in back and sacrum; worse while sitting*; better, walking or lying. Weakness in legs and backache after emissions.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Aching in wrist-joints. Shooting into thighs from liver. *Weak knees*. Trembling in limbs. Tingling in feet. Foot-sweat, mostly between toes.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Unrefreshing; *disturbed by lewd dreams*.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Dry and pimply. Pimples about nates, chin, hairy scalp.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Cannab. Ind; Sepia; Zinc; Agnus; Selen*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Sixth to thirtieth potency.

remedies.heading: COCA-ERYTHROXYLON COCA
remedies.commonName: The Divine Plant of the Incas-but the Spanish priests denounced it as "un delusion del demonio"
remedies.intro: The mountaineer's remedy. Useful in a variety of complaints incidental to mountain climbing, such as palpitation, dyspnoea, anxiety and insomnia. Exhausted nervous system from physical and mental strain. Caries of teeth. *Loss of voice*.--Give 5-6 drops, every half hour, two hours before expected demand on voice. Nocturnal enuresis. Emphysema (*Quebracho*).

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Melancholy; bashful, ill at ease in society, irritable, delights in solitude and obscurity. Sense of right and wrong abolished.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text:
Fainting fit from climbing mountains. Shocks coming from occiput with vertigo. *Noises in ear*. Headache with vertigo, preceded by flashes of light. Like a band across forehead. Diplopia. Tongue furred.
*Headaches of high altitudes*. Tinnitus.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Peppery sensation in mouth. Longing for alcoholic liquors and tobacco. Great satiety for a long time. Incarcerated flatus; rises with noise and violence, as if it would split the oesophagus. Tympanitic distention of abdomen. No appetite but for sweets.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: *Palpitation*, with weak heart and dyspnoea.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Diabetes, with impotency (*Phos ac*).

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Hawking of small, transparent pieces of mucus. Weak vocal cords. *Hoarseness*; worse after talking. *Want of breath, short breath*, especially in aged athletes, and alcoholic users. Haemoptysis. *Asthma*, spasmodic variety.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Can find no rest anywhere, but sleepy. Nervousness and nightly restlessness during teething.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Better*, from wine; riding, quick motion in open air. *Worse*, ascending, high altitudes.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: *Ars; Paulin; Cyp; Chamom*.
Antidote: *Gels*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture to third attenuation.

remedies.heading: COCAINUM HYDROCHLORICUM
remedies.intro:
Besides the great usefulness of Cocaine as a local anaesthetic, it has specific homeopathic uses, though the symptoms are mainly clinical only.
Sensation as *if small foreign bodies or worms were under the skin*.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Talkative. Constant desire to do something great, *to undertake vast feats of strength*. Cerebral activity. Frightful persecutory hallucinations; *sees and feels bugs and worms. Moral sense blunted*. Personal appearance neglected. Thinks he hears unpleasant remarks about himself. Hallucinations of hearing. Irrational *jealousy*. Insomnia.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Throbbing and bursting sensation. *Pupils dilated*. Hearing greatly increased. Roaring and noises in head.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Glaucoma, increased tension, decreased corneal sensibility. Eyes staring, expressionless.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Dry, burning, tickling, constricted, paralysis of muscles of deglutition. Speech difficult.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Loss of appetite for solid food. *Likes sweets. Haemorrhages* from bowels, stomach.

sections.heading: Nervous System
sections.text: Chorea; paralysis agitans; alcoholic tremors and senile trembling. Local sensory paralysis. Formication and numbness in hands and forearms.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Restless, cannot sleep for hours after retiring.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Coldness with intense pallor.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Stovain* (an analgesic, a vasomotor dilator). Antidote to disagreeable effects occasionally resulting from injection of cocaine into skin or gums, drop doses of nitroglycer. 1 % sol.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Lower potencies. As a local application to mucous membranes, 2-4 %.

remedies.heading: COCCINELLA SEPTEMPUNCTATA
remedies.intro: This remedy ought to be remembered in neuralgias, teeth, gums, mouth, etc. Is awakened by profuse accumulation of saliva. Uvula feels too long. Symptoms of hydrophobia; worse, by any bright object.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Pain in forehead over right eye, sensitive to touch; from superior molars to forehead. Aching in temples and occiput. Rush of blood to face. *Throbbing toothache. Cold sensation in teeth* and mouth (*Cistus*). Periodical attacks of frontal neuralgia. Cannot open eyes during paroxysm. Pain worse from any bright object; better, sleep.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Hiccough and burning in stomach.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: *Pain in region of kidneys and loins*. Icy cold extremities.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Canth; Magn c*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third potency.

remedies.heading: COCCULUS INDICUS
remedies.intro: Within the sphere of action of Cocculus are many spasmodic and paretic affections, notably those affecting one-half of the body. Affects the cerebrum, will not cure convulsive seizures proceeding from the spinal cord (A. E. Hinsdale) *Painful contracture* of limbs and trunk; tetanus. Many of the evil *effects of night-watching* are relieved by it. It shows a special, attraction *for light-haired females*, especially during pregnancy, causing much nausea and backache. Unmarried and childless women, sensitive and romantic girls, etc. All its symptoms are worse riding in a carriage or on shipboard; hence its use in seasickness. Sensation of *hollowness*, or emptiness, as if parts had gone to sleep. Feels too weak to talk loud.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Capricious. Heavy and stupid. *Time passes too quickly*; absorbed in reveries. Inclination to sing irresistible. Slow of comprehension. Mind benumbed. *Profound sadness*. Cannot bear contradiction. Speaks hastily. Very anxious about the health of others.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Vertigo, nausea, *especially when riding* or sitting up. Sense of emptiness in head. Headache *in occiput* and nape; worse, lying on back of head. Sick headache from carriage riding, cannot lie on back part of head. Pupils contracted. Opening and shutting sensation, especially in occiput. Trembling of head. Pain in eyes as if torn out of head.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Paralysis of facial nerve. Cramp-like pain in masseter muscle; *worse, opening mouth*. Prosopalgia in afternoon, with wide radiations of pain.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Nausea from riding in cars, boat, etc, or looking at boat in motion; worse on becoming cold or taking cold. Nausea, with faintness and vomiting. *Aversion to food*, drink, tobacco. *Metallic taste*. Paralysis of muscles preventing deglutition. Dryness of oesophagus. Seasickness (*Resorcin*. 1x). Cramp, in stomach during and after meal. Hiccough and spasmodic yawning. Loss of appetite. Desire for cold drinks, especially beer. Sensation in stomach as if one had been a long time without food until hunger was gone. Smell of food disgusts (*Colch*).

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Distended, with wind, and feeling as *if full of sharp stones when moving*; better, lying on one side or the other. *Pain in abdominal ring*, as if something were forced through. *Abdominal muscles weak*; it seems as if a hernia would take place.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Dysmenorrhoea, with profuse dark menses. Too early menses, clotted, with spasmodic colic. Painful pressing in uterine region, followed by haemorrhoids. Purulent, gushing leucorrhoea between menses; *very weakening*, can scarcely speak. So weak during menstruation, scarcely able to stand.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Sensation of emptiness and cramp in chest. Dyspnoea as from constriction of trachea, as if irritated by smoke. Choking constriction in upper part of oesophagus, oppressing breathing and inducing cough.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Cracking of cervical vertebrae when moving head. *Paralytic pain in small of the back*. Pain *in shoulder and arms as if bruised*. Pressure in scapula and nape. Stiffness on moving shoulders.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Lameness; worse by bending. *Trembling* and pain in limbs. Arms go to sleep. One-sided paralysis; worse after sleep. Hands are alternately hot and cold; numbness and cold sweat now of one, now of the other hand. Numb and unsteady. *Knees crack on motion*. Lower limbs very weak. Inflammatory swelling of knee. Intensely painful, paralytic drawing. Limbs straightened out, painful when flexed.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Spasmodic yawning. Coma vigil. Constant drowsiness. After loss of sleep, night-watching, nursing.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Chill, with flatulent colic, nausea, vertigo, coldness of lower extremities, and heat of head. Sweat general. Nervous form of low fever. *Chilliness, with perspiration, and heat of skin*.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, eating, after loss of sleep, open air, smoking, riding, swimming, touch, noise, jar; afternoon. Menstrual period. After emotional disturbance.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidotes:; *Coffee; Nux*.
Compare: *Picrotoxin*-alkaloid of Cocculus--(epilepsy, attacks in the morning on leaving horizontal position, hernia, locomotor ataxia, night-sweats); *Symphoricarpus* (morning sickness); *Petrol; Puls; Ignat*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.heading: COCCUS CACTI
remedies.intro: The clinical application of the symptoms of this remedy, place it among the medicines for spasmodic and whooping coughs, and catarrhal conditions of the bladder; spasmodic pains in kidneys, with visceral tenesmus. Anuria, anasarca, ascites.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Early morning or afternoon sadness.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Suboccipital soreness; worse after sleep and exertion. Headache, worse from lying on back, better with the head high. Dull pain over right eye in morning. *Sensation of a foreign body between upper lid and eyeball*. Distress from cinders lodged in eye.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Constant hawking from enlarged uvula; coryza, with inflamed fauces; *accumulation of thick viscid mucus*, which is expectorated with great difficulty. *Tickling in larynx*. Sensation of a crumb behind larynx, must swallow continually; brushing teeth causes cough. Fauces very sensitive. Suffocative cough; worse, first waking, with tough, white mucus, which strangles. Spasmodic morning cough. *Whooping cough attacks end with vomiting of this tough mucus*. Chronic bronchitis complicated with gravel; large quantities of albuminous, tenacious mucus, are expectorated. Walking against wind takes breath away.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Sensation as if everything were pressed toward the heart.

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: Urging to urinate; *brick-red sediment. Urinary calculi, haematuria, urates*, and uric acid; lancinating pains from kidney to bladder. Deep-colored, thick urine. Dysuria.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses too early, profuse, *black* and thick; *dark clots*, with dysuria. Intermittent menstruation; flow only in evening and at night. *Large clots* escape when passing water. *Labia* inflamed.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, left side, after sleep, touch, pressure of clothing, brushing teeth, slightest exertion. *Better*, walking.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Canth; Cact; Sars*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Lower triturations.
