sections.text: Sensation as if heart were suspended. Palpitation and *burning in heart region. Weak, rapid pulse; intermits*, due to digestive disturbance. Threatened heart failure.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Great exhaustion. Stitches in region of kidneys and right scapula. *Small of back feels weak*. Stiffness and paralytic feeling in back. Burning in spine (*Guaco*). Severe backache during pregnancy, and after miscarriage. Hip-disease. Pain in nates and thighs and hip-joint. Lumbago with sudden sharp pains extending up and down back and to thighs.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: *Backs and legs give out*. Uneasiness heaviness, and tearing in limbs and jerking. Tearing pain in limbs with swelling. Limbs sensitive to pressure. White swelling of knee. Tearing in arms from shoulder to wrist. Lacerating in wrist-joint. Paralysis of old people, and dropsical affections. Limbs go to sleep easily. Tips of toes and fingers painful. *Soles very sensitive*. Itching of great toe, with pain. *Pain from hip to knee*. *Pain in knees*.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Burning as from a mustard plaster.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Drowsy after eating. Wakes about two o'clock and cannot sleep again.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, after coition; in cold weather; from soup and coffee; in morning about three o'clock; lying on left and painful side. *Better*, in warm weather, though moist; during day, while moving about.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Complementary: *Carbo*; (Lowness of vitality may suggest a preliminary course of Carbo to nurse up recuperation to the point that Kali carb would come in helpfully). Follows *Nux* often in stomach and bladder troubles.
Compare: *Kali salicylicum* (vomiting, especially of pregnancy; arteriosclerosis, with chronic rheumatism); *kali silicum* (gouty nodosities); *Kali aceticum* (diabetes, diarrhoea, dropsy, alkaline urine, very much increased in quantity); *Kali citricum* (Bright's disease-1 gr to wine-glass of water); *Kali ferrocyanatum*-Prussian blue--(physical and mental prostration following infection. Inability to sustained routine work. Neuralgic affections depending on impoverished blood and exhausted nerve centers, especially spinal. Fatty and functional heart troubles. Pulse weak, small, irregular. Uterine symptoms, like Sepia, bearing-down sensation and gastric sinking; profuse, pus-like leucorrhoea and passive haemorrhage; use 6x); *Kali oxalicum* (lumbago, convulsions); *Kali picro-nitricum* and *kali pricricum* (jaundice, violent eructations); *kali tartaricum* (paraplegia); *Kali telluricum* (garlicky odor of breath, salivation, swollen tongue). Also compare: *Calc; Ammon phos; Phos; Lycop; Bry; Natrum; Stann; Sepia*.
Antidotes: *Camph; Coffea*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Thirtieth and higher. Sixth trit. Do not repeat too often. Use cautiously in old gouty cases, advanced Bright's and tuberculosis.

remedies.heading: KALIUM CHLORICUM
remedies.intro: Acts very destructively upon the kidneys, producing a croupous nephritis, hemoglobinuria, etc. Parenchymatous nephritis with stomatitis. Produces most acute ulcerative and follicular stomatitis. *Noma. Toxaemic conditions of pregnancy* (urinary symptoms). Chronic nephritis; hepatitis. Septicaemia. Anaemia.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Profuse secretion of acid saliva. Whole mucous surface red, tumid, with gray-based ulcers. Tongue swollen. *Stomatitis*-aphthous and *gangrenous*. Fetor. Mercurial stomatitis (as a mouth wash).

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Feeling of weight in epigastric and umbilical region. Flatulence. Vomiting of greenish-black matter.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Diarrhoea; profuse, greenish mucus.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Albuminous, scanty, suppressed. Haematuria; diuresis. Nucleo-albumin and bile, high Phosphoric acid, with low total solids.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Jaundice. Itching miliary or papular eruptions. Discolored; chocolate tint.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Second to sixth potency. Use cautiously locally as it is poisonous.

remedies.heading: KALIUM CYANATUM
remedies.intro: Sudden sinking sensation. Cancer of tongue and agonizing neuralgia have been benefited by this drug. Sick headache; sciatica; epilepsy.

sections.heading: Tongue
sections.text: Ulcer of tongue, with indurated edges. Speech difficult. Power of speech lost but intelligence intact.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Severe neuralgia in temporal region, recurring daily at same hour. Pain in orbital and supra-maxillary region, with screaming and loss of consciousness.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Cough prevents sleep; respiration weak; cannot take deep breath.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, from 4 am to 4 pm.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Platin; Stann; Cedron; Mezer; Mur ac*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Sixth potency and 200th.

remedies.heading: KALIUM IODATUM
remedies.intro: The profuse, watery, acrid coryza that the drug produces serves as a sure guiding symptom, especially when associated with pain in frontal sinus. It acts prominently on fibrous and connective tissues, producing infiltration, oedema, etc. *Glandular swellings*. Purpura and haemorrhagic diathesis. *Syphilis* may be indicated in all stages: 1. In acute form with evening remitting fever, going off in nightly perspiration. 2. Second stage, mucous membranes and skin ulcerations. 3. Tertiary symptoms; nodes. Give material doses. *Diffused sensitiveness* --(glands, scalp, etc). Rheumatism in *neck, back*, feet, especially heels and soles; worse, cold and wet. Iodide of Potass in material doses acts in the different forms of Fungoid disease (thrush, ringworm, etc), offer simulating syphilis and bacterial diseases like tuberculosis. Symptoms like loss of weight, spitting of blood, etc. Tea-taster's cough due to inhaling the fungus; a also brings about often favorable reaction in many chronic ailments even when not clearly symptomatically indicated.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Sad, anxious; harsh temper. Irritable; congestion to head, heat and throbbing.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Pain through *sides* of head. Violent headache. Cranium swells up in hard lump. Pain intense over eyes and *root of nose*. Brain feels enlarged. Hard nodes, with severe pain. *Facial neuralgia*. Lancinating pain in upper jaw.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Red, swollen. Tip of nose red; *profuse, acrid, hot, watery, thin discharge. Ozaena, with perforated septum*. Sneezing. Nasal catarrh, involving frontal sinus. Stuffiness and dryness of nose, without discharge. Profuse, *cool*, greenish, unirritating discharges.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Conjunctiva red, injected; profuse lachrymation. *Syphilitic iritis*. Pustular keratitis and chemosis. Bony tumors of the orbit.

sections.heading: Ear
sections.text: Noises in ear. Boring pain in ears.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Saliva increased. Faintness at epigastrium. Cold food and drink, especially milk, aggravate. Much thirst. Throbbing, painful burning. Flatulence.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses late, profuse. During menses uterus feels as if squeezed. Corrosive leucorrhoea, with subacute inflammatory conditions of the womb in young married women. Fibroid tumors, metritis, sub-involution, hypertrophy, 1x or 1 gr crude, 3 times a day.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Violent cough; worse in morning. Pulmonary oedema. *Larynx feels raw*. Laryngeal oedema. Awakes choking. *Expectoration like soap-suds, greenish*. Pneumonia, when hepatization commences. *Pneumococcic meningitis*. Stitching pains through lungs to back. Asthma. Dyspnoea on ascending, with pain in heart. Hydrothorax (*Merc sulph*). *Pleuritic effusion. Cold travels downward to chest*.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Severe bone-pains. Periosteum thickened, especially tibia; sensitive to touch (*Kali b; Asaf*). Rheumatism; pains at night and in damp weather. Contraction of joints. *Rheumatism of knees with effusion*. Pain in small of back and coccyx. Pain in hip, forcing limping. *Sciatica*; cannot stay in bed; worse at night and lying on affected side. Formication of lower extremities when sitting, better lying down.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text:
Purple spots; worse on legs. Acne, hydroa. Small boils.
*Glands* enlarged, indurated. Hives. *Rough nodules* all over, worse any covering; heat of body intense. Fissured anus of infants. Tendency to oedematous swellings, eyelids, mouth, uvula, etc. *Acne rosacea*.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, warm clothing, warm room, at night, damp weather. *Better*, motion, open air.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidote: *Hepar*.
Compare: *Iod; Mercur; Sulph; Mezer. Chopheenee*, a Hindoo remedy for syphilitic eruptions, ulcerations and bone-pains. Used in tincture.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Crude drug, in material official dosage, but remember Dr. Meyhoffer's statements in his chronic diseases of organs of respiration: "From the moment the drug produces pathogenetic symptoms, it exaggerates the function of the tissue, exhausts the already diminished vitality, and thence, instead of stimulating the organic cell in the direction of life, impairs or abolishes its power of contraction. We use, as a rule, the first dilution from 6 to 20 drops a day; if after a week no decided progress is visible, one drop of the tincture of Iodine is added to each hundred of the first dilution. In this way, the mucous tubercles, gummy deposits and ulcerations resulting therefrom in the larynx undergo a favorable termination in laryngeal syphilis. " When strictly homeopathically indicated, as in acute respiratory affections to third potency.

remedies.heading: KALIUM MURIATICUM
remedies.intro: Although not proven, this remedy has a wide clinical use, through its introduction by Schuessler. It certainly is of great value in catarrhal affections, in sub-acute inflammatory states, fibrinous exudations, and glandular swellings. *White or gray coating of base of tongue*, and expectoration of thick, white phlegm, seem to be special guiding symptoms. Bursitis praepatellaris.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Imagines he must starve. Headache, with vomiting. Crusta lactea. Dandruff.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: White mucus, purulent scabs. Superficial ulcer. Trachoma. Corneal opacities.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: *Chronic, catarrhal conditions of the middle ear*. Glands about the ear swollen. *Snapping and noises in the ear*. Threatened mastoid. Great effusion about the auricle.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Catarrh; phlegm white, thick. Vault of pharynx covered with adherent crusts. Stuffy cold. Nosebleed (*Arn; Bry*).

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Cheek swollen and painful.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Aphthae; thrush; white ulcers in mouth. Swollen glands about jaw and neck. Coating of tongue *grayish-white*, dryish, or slimy.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: *Follicular tonsillitis*. Tonsils inflamed; enlarged so much, can hardly breathe. Grayish patches or spots in the throat and tonsils. Adherent crusts in vault of pharynx. "Hospital" sore throat. Eustachian catarrh.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: *Fatty or rich food causes indigestion*. Vomiting of white, opaque mucus; water gathers in the mouth. Pain in the stomach, with constipation. Bulimia; hunger disappears by drinking water.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Abdominal tenderness and swelling. Flatulence. Thread-worms, causing itching at the anus.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Constipation; light-colored stools. Diarrhoea, after fatty food; clay-colored, white, or slimy stools. Dysentery; purging, with slimy stools. *Haemorrhoids*; bleeding; blood dark and thick; fibrinous, clotted.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menstruation too late or suppressed, checked or too early; excessive discharge; *dark-clotted*, or tough, black blood, like tar (*Plat*). Leucorrhoea; discharge of milky-white mucus, thick, non-irritating, bland. Morning sickness, with vomiting of white phlegm. Bunches in breast feel quite soft and are *tender*.

sections.heading: Respiratory Organs
sections.text: Loss of voice; hoarseness. Asthma, with gastric derangements; mucus white and hard to cough up. Loud, noisy stomach cough; cough short, acute, and spasmodic, like whooping-cough; expectoration thick and white. Rattling sounds of air passing through thick, tenacious mucus in the bronchi; difficult to cough up.

sections.heading: Back and Extremities
sections.text: Rheumatic fever; exudation and *swelling around the joints*. Rheumatic pains felt only during motion, or increased by it. Nightly rheumatic pains; worse from warmth of bed; lightning-like from small of back to feet; must get out of bed and sit up. Hands get stiff while writing.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Acne, erythema, and eczema, with *vesicles* containing thick, white contents. Dry, flour-like scales on the skin (*Arsenic*). Bursitis.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, rich food, fats, motion.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Bellad* which Kali mur follows well in catarrhal and hypertrophic conditions. *Kino* (otorrhoea, with stitches in right ear); *Bry; Mercur; Puls; Sulph*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text:
Third to twelfth potency.
External use in skin affections with burning sensation.

remedies.heading: KALIUM NITRICUM
remedies.intro: Often indicated in asthma, also valuable in cardiac asthma; of great value in *sudden dropsical swellings over the whole body*. Gastro-intestinal inflammation, with much debility, and relapse in phthisis, call for this remedy. Suppurative nephritis.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Scalp very sensitive. Headache, with vertigo, as if falling to right side and backwards; worse, stooping. Ennui.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Vision becomes clouded. Turbid corpus vitreum (*Arn; Ham; Solan n; Phos*). Variegated-colored rings before eyes. Burning and lachrymation.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Sneezing. Swollen feeling; *worse, right nostril*. Point red and itching. Polypus (*Sang nit*).

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Tongue red, with burning pimples; burns at tip. Throat constricted and sore.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Thin, watery, bloody. Membranous shreds, with tenesmus. *Diarrhoea from eating veal*.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses too early, profuse, *black*; preceded and with violent backache. Leucorrhoea. Burning pains in the ovarian region only during menses (*Zinc* after).

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Hoarseness. Dry, morning cough, with pain in chest and bloody expectoration. Bronchitis, with sharp, short, dry, hacking cough. *Asthma*, with excessive dyspnoea, nausea, dull stitches, and burning in chest. Dyspnoea so great that breath cannot be held long enough to drink, though thirsty. Chest feels constricted. Oppression worse in morning. Sour-smelling expectoration. Expectoration of clotted blood, after hawking mucus. Acute exacerbations in phthisis; congestion of lungs. *Spasmodic croup*; paroxysm of crowing. Laryngeal diphtheria.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Pulse weak, *small*, thready. Violent stitch in praecordia, and beating of heart.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Stitches between shoulder-blades. Tearing and sticking in shoulders and joints. Hands and fingers seem swollen.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, eating veal; towards morning and in afternoon. *Better*, drinking sips of water.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidotes: *Opium; Nitr sp dulc*.
Antidote to Opium and Morphine poisoning, 8-10 grains to glass of water.
Compare: *Gun-powder* (Nitre with sulphur and charcoal-2x trit. "Blood poisoning. " Septic suppuration. Protractive against wound infection. Antidote to Ivy and Primula rash (Clarke) *Herpes facialis*; crops of boils. Carbuncles). Osteo-myelitis. *Cannab sat* (which contains a large amount of *Kali nit*).
*Lycop; Sanguin; Allium sat; Antimon iod*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.heading: KALIUM PERMANGANATUM
remedies.intro: Intense irritation of nose, throat, and larynx. Diphtheria. Dysmenorrhoea. Bites of serpents and for other animal poisons. Septic conditions; tissues infiltrated with tendency to sloughing.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Bleeding from nose. Nasal discharge. Smarts and irritates. Constrictive, smarting sensation in throat. Larynx feels raw. Short, hacking cough.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Swollen and painful. Everything hawked up streaked with blood. Posterior nares painful. Muscles of neck feel sore. Swollen uvula. Fetor of breath.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text:
Locally, 1 dram to a quart of water, to correct fetor in cancer, ulcer, ozaena, and other foul odors. Also as an injection in leucorrhoea and gonorrhoea. Internally, 2x dilution in water. Saturated solution locally in eruption of smallpox.
Potassium Permanganate for Morphine Poisoning.--Potassium permanganate is recognized as being the most effective chemical antidote in cases of morphine or opium poisoning, acting directly on the morphine and oxidizing it to less toxic substances. To be effective the permanganate must come in direct contact with the opium or morphine in the stomach; hypodermatic or intravenous injections are absolutely useless, as the salt would be decomposed by the blood serum at once. The approved treatment is administration of two to five grains of potassium permanganate in dilute aqueous solution as soon as possible after the poison is taken, this amounts to be increased if very large doses of the poison have been taken. Washing out the stomach with a quantity of 1 to 500 solution of permanganate is also recommended, using at least a pint of this solution either by a stomach pump or by enforced vomiting. *Permang of Potash* counteracts effects of alkaloids of many poisonous plants. Owing to its oxidizing powers if given before the alkaloid has been absorbed (Dr. Chestnut in Dept of Agriculture).

remedies.heading: KALIUM PHOSPHORICUM
remedies.intro: One of the greatest nerve remedies. *Prostration*. Weak and tired. Especially adapted to the young. Marked disturbance of the sympathetic nervous system. Conditions arising from *want of nerve power*, neurasthenia, mental and physical depression, are wonderfully improved this remedy. The causes are usually excitement, overwork and worry. Besides, *it corresponds to states of adynamia and decay*, gangrenous conditions. In these two directions it has won many clinical laurels. Remember it in the treatment of suspected malignant tumors. After removal of cancer when in healing process skin is drawn *tight* over the wound. Delayed labor.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Anxiety, *nervous dread*, lethargy. Indisposition to meet people. Extreme lassitude and depression. Very nervous, starts easily, *irritable*. Brain-fag; hysteria; *night terrors*. Somnambulance. Loss of memory. *Slightest labor seems a heavy task*. Great despondency about business. Shyness; disinclined to converse.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text:
Occipital headache; better, after rising. Vertigo, from lying, on standing up, from sitting, and when looking upward (*Granat*).
*Cerebral anaemia*. Headache of students, and those worn out by fatigue. Headaches are relieved by gentle motion. Headache, with weary, empty, gone feeling at stomach (*Ign; Sep*).

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Weakness of sight; loss of perceptive power; after diphtheria; from exhaustion. Drooping of eyelids (*Caust*).

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: *Humming and buzzing in the ears*.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Nasal disease, with offensive odor; fetid discharge.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Livid and sunken, with hollow eyes. Right-sided neuralgia relieved by cold applications.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: *Breath offensive, fetid*. Tongue coated brownish, like mustard. *Excessively dry*, in the morning. Toothache, with easily-bleeding gums; they have a bright-red seam on them. Gums spongy and receding (*Caps; Hamam; Lach*).

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Gangrenous sore throat. Paralysis of the vocal cords.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: A nervous "gone" sensation at the pit of the stomach (*Ign; Sep; Sulph*). Feels seasick without nausea.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Diarrhoea; foul, *putrid odor*; occasioned by fright, with depression and exhaustion. Diarrhoea while eating. Dysentery; stools consist of pure blood; patient becomes delirious; abdomen swells. Cholera; stools have the appearance of rice water (*Verat; Ars; Jatrop*). Prolapsus recti (*Ign; Pod*).

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menstruation *too late or too scanty* in pale, irritable, sensitive, lachrymose females. Too profuse discharge, deep-red or blackish-red, thin and not coagulating; sometimes with offensive odor. Feeble and ineffectual labor pains.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Nocturnal emissions; sexual power diminished utter prostration after coitus (*Kali carb*).

sections.heading: Urinary Organs
sections.text: Enuresis. Incontinence of urine. Bleeding from the urethra. *Very yellow urine*.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Asthma; least food aggravates. Short breath on going upstairs. Cough; *yellow* expectoration.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Paralytic lameness in back and extremities. Exertion aggravates. Pains, with depression, and subsequent exhaustion.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Subnormal temperature.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, excitement, worry, mental and physical exertion; eating, cold, early morning. *Better*, warmth, rest, nourishment.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Kali hypophosph* (*Debility with wasting of muscular tissue*. Phosphaturia with general anaemia or leucocythemia. Effects of excessive tea drinking. Chronic bronchitis where the expectoration is *thick* and *fetid*, sometimes *scanty and tough*. Dose.--5 grains of crude to 3x). *Genista*.--Dyer's Weed--(contains scopolamin; frontal headache and vertigo, worse motion, better open air and eating. Dry throat, awakes with waterbrash. Itching eruption on elbows, knees and ankles. Promotes diuresis in dropsical conditions). *Macrozamia Spiralis* (Extreme debility after severe illness; collapse. Weariness from no assignable cause, no pains. Boring pain at vertex; vomiting and retching all night; impossible to open eyes, giddiness and cold). *Zinc; Gels; Cimicif; Laches; Mur ac*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to twelfth trituration. The highest potencies seem to be indicated in certain cases.

remedies.heading: KALIUM SILICICUM
remedies.intro: A deep-acting remedy. Lassitude is very marked. Desire to lie down all the time. Emaciation.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Absent-minded, anxious, indolent, timid. Feeble will power. Head congested, blood surges from body to head. Vertigo, coldness of head; photophobia. Nasal catarrh, discharge *bloody*, excoriating, offensive nose, swollen, ulcerated.

sections.heading: Gastric
sections.text: Weight in stomach after eating, nausea, pain, flatulence. Pain in liver region. Constipation. Construction of anus during stool.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Stiffness over body and limbs. Creeping sensation over limbs. Twitching of muscles. Weak and weary.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, open air, drafts, cold, exertion, motion uncovering, bathing.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Higher potencies.

remedies.heading: KALIUM SULPHURICUM
remedies.intro: Ailments accompanied by profuse desquamation. Applicable to the later stages of inflammation. *Yellow*, mucous and serous discharges, profuse and intermittent. Has been found of much use in oxaluria.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Rheumatic headache, beginning in evening. Bald spots. Dandruff and scaldhead.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Eustachian deafness. Discharge of *yellow* matter (*Hydr*).

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text:
Cold, *with yellow*, slimy expectoration. Nose obstructed. Smell lost (*Nat mur*).
*Engorgement of the nasal pharyngeal mucous membrane*, mouth breathing, snoring, etc, remaining after removal of adenoids.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Aches in heated room. Epithelioma.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Tongue coated yellow and slimy. Insipid, pappy taste. Gums painful. Burning thirst, nausea, and vomiting. Load feeling. Dread of hot drinks.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Colicky pains; abdomen feels cold to touch; tympanitic, tense. Yellow, slimy diarrhoea. Constipation, with haemorrhoids (*Sulph*).

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Gonorrhoea; discharge slimy, yellowish-green. Orchitis. Gleet.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses too late, scanty, with feeling of weight in abdomen. Metrorrhagia.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Coarse rales. *Rattling of mucus in chest* (*Tart em*). Post-grippal cough, especially in children. Bronchial asthma, with yellow expectoration. Cough; worse in evening and in hot atmosphere. Croupy hoarseness (*Hep; Spong*).

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Pain in nape, back and limbs, worse in warm room. *Shifting, wandering pains*.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Rise of temperature at night. Intermittent fever, with yellow, slimy tongue.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Psoriasis (*Ars; Thyroid*). Eczema; burning, itching, papular eruption. Nettle-rash. Polypi. Epithelioma. Seborrhoea. Favus. Ring-worm of scalp or beard with abundant scales.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, in evening, heated room. *Better*, cool, open air.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Kali sulph chromico.--Alum of chrome*-3x (Produces in the nasal passages very fine threads from the septum to external wall; affections of nasal fossae and hay-fever. Chronic colds. Sneezing, red, watery eyes, irritation of mucous membrane). *Pulsat; Kali bich; Nat m*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to twelfth potency.

remedies.heading: KALMIA LATIFOLIA
remedies.intro: A rheumatic remedy. Pains shift rapidly. Nausea and slow pulse frequently accompanying. Has also a prominent action on the heart. In small doses, it accelerates the heart's action; in larger it moderates it greatly. Neuralgia; *pains shoot downwards, with numbness. Fulgurating pains of locomotor ataxia*. Protracted and continuous *fevers*, with tympanites. Paralytic sensations; pains and aching in limbs accompany nearly every group of symptoms. *Albuminuria*.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: *Vertigo*; worse stooping. Confusion of brain. Pain in front and temporal region from head to nape and to teeth; from cardiac origin.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Vision impaired. *Stiff, drawing sensation when moving eyes*. Rheumatic iritis. Scleritis, *pain increased by moving the eye*.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Neuralgia; worse *right side*. Stitches in tongue. Stitches and tearing in bones of jaw and face.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Warm, glowing sensation in epigastrium. *Nausea*; vomiting. *Pain in pit of stomach; worse by bending forward; relieved by sitting erect*. Bilious attacks, with nausea, vertigo, and headache. Sensation of something being pressed under the epigastrium.

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: Frequent, with sharp pains in lumbar region. Post-scarlatinal nephritis.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Weak, *slow* pulse (*Dig; Apoc can*). Fluttering of heart, with anxiety. *Palpitation; worse leaning forward*. Gouty and rheumatic metastasis of heart. Tachycardia, with pain (*Thyroid*). Tobacco heart. Dyspnoea and pressure from epigastrium toward the heart. *Sharp pains take away the breath*. Shooting through chest above heart into shoulder-blades. Frequent pulse. Heart's action tumultuous, rapid and visible. Paroxysms of anguish around heart.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses too early, or suppressed, with pain in limbs and back and inside of thighs. Leucorrhoea follows menses.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Pain from neck down arm; in upper three dorsal vertebrae extending to shoulder-blade. Pain down back, as if it would break; in localized regions of spine; through shoulders. *Lumbar pains, of nervous origin*.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Deltoid rheumatism especially right. Pains from hips to knees and feet. *Pains affect a large part of a limb*, or several joints, and pass through quickly. Weakness, numbness, pricking, and sense of coldness in limbs. *Pains along ulnar nerve*, index finger. Joints red, hot, swollen. Tingling and numbness of left arm.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Sleepless, *wakes very early in morning*.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, leaning forward (*opposite, Kali carb*); looking down; motion, open air.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Kalmia contains Arbutin g v. *Derris pinuta* (of great service in neuralgic headaches of rheumatic origin).
Compare: *Spigelia; Pulsat*.
Complementary: *Benz acid*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture, to sixth potency.

remedies.heading: KAOLINUM
remedies.intro: A remedy for croup and bronchitis.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Itching and burning. Discharge *yellow. Sore, scabby*, stopped up.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: *Soreness of chest* along trachea; cannot stand percussion. Gray sputa. Capillary bronchitis. Larynx and chest sore. Membranous croup-extends down trachea.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Lower triturations.

remedies.heading: KOLA
remedies.intro:
Neurasthenia. Regulates the circulation, is tonic and anti-diarrheic, regulates cardiac rhythm and acts diuretically. Weak heart.
The remedy for the drinking habit. It promotes the appetite and digestion, and lessens the craving for liquor. *Asthma*. Gives power to endure prolonged physical exertion without taking food and without feeling fatigued.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: *Coca*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Three to ten drops, even one dram doses, three times a day.

remedies.heading: KOUSSO
remedies.intro: A *Vermifuge*-Nausea and vomiting, vertigo, praecordial anxiety slowing and irregular pulse, subdelirium and collapse. Rapid and extreme prostration. To expel tapeworm.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: 1/2 oz. Mix with warm water and let stand 15 minutes; stir well and administer. May be preceded by a little lemon juice (Merrell).

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Mallotus*-Kamala-An efficient remedy for tapeworm in 30-60 minims of tincture taken in cinnamon water.

remedies.heading: KREOSOTUM
remedies.intro:
Kreosotum is a mixture of phenols obtained from this distillation.
Pulsations all over the body, and profuse bleeding from small wounds. Very severe, old neuralgic affections; pains rather aggravated by rest. *Excoriating*, burning, and offensive discharges. Haemorrhages, ulcerations, cancerous affections. Rapid decomposition of fluids and secretions, and burning pains. Overgrown, poorly developed children. Post-climacteric diseases. Tumefaction, puffiness, gangrene. Ailings of teething children.

sections.heading: Mental
sections.text: Music causes weeping and palpitation. Vanishing of thought; stupid, forgetful, peevish, irritable. Child wants everything but throws it away when given.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Dull pain, as from a board pressing against forehead. Menstrual headache. Occipital pain (*Gels; Zinc pic*).

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Salty lachrymation. Lids red and swollen.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Eruption around and pimples within. Difficult hearing and buzzing.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Sick, suffering expression; hot, cheeks red.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Lips red, bleeding. *Very painful dentition*; child will not sleep. *Very rapid decay of teeth, with spongy, bleeding gums*; teeth dark and crumbly (*Staph; Ant c*). Putrid odor and bitter taste.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Offensive smell and discharge. Chronic catarrh of old people. Acrid rawness. Lupus (*Ars*).

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Burning, choking sensation. *Putrid odor*.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Nausea; vomiting of food several hours after eating; of sweetish water in the morning. Feeling of coldness, as of ice water in stomach. Soreness; better eating. Painful hard spot. Haematemesis. Bitter taste after a swallow of water.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Distended. Burning haemorrhoids. Diarrhoea; very offensive; dark brown. Bloody, fetid stools. *Cholera infantum* in connection with painful dentition, green stools, nausea, dry skin, exhaustion, etc.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: *Offensive*. Violent itching of vulva and vagina, worse when urinating. Can urinate only when lying; cannot get out of bed quick enough during first sleep. Dreams of urinating. Enuresis in the first part of night. *Must hurry when desire comes to urinate*.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Corrosive itching within vulva, burning and swelling of labia; violent itching between labia and thighs. During menses, *difficult hearing*; buzzing and roaring; eruption after. Burning and soreness in external and internal parts. Leucorrhoea, yellow, acrid; odor of green corn; worse between periods. Haemorrhage after coition. Menses too early, prolonged. Vomiting of pregnancy, with ptyalism. *Menstrual flow intermits* (*Puls*); ceases on sitting or walking; reappears on lying down. Pain worse after menses. Lochia offensive; *intermits*.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: *Hoarse, with pain in larynx*. Cough; worse evening, with efforts to vomit, with pain in chest. Raw burning in chest; pains and oppression. Cough after influenza (*Eriodyction*). Winter coughs of old people, *with heavy pressure on sternum*. Gangrene of lungs. After every cough, *copious, purulent expectoration*. Haemoptysis; periodic attacks. Sternum feels pressed in.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Dragging backache, extending to genitals and down thighs. Great debility.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Pain in joints, hip and knee. Boring pain in hip-joints. Scapulae sore.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Itching, worse towards evening. Burning in soles. Senile gangrene. Small wounds bleed freely (*Crot; Lach; Phos*). Pustules and herpes. Ecchymosis; dorsal surface of fingers and hands eczematous.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Disturbed with tossing. Paralytic sensation in limbs on waking. Anxious dreams of pursuit, fire, erections, etc.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, in open air, cold rest, when lying; after menstruation. *Better*, from warmth, motion, warm diet.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidote: *Nux*. Inimical: *Carbo*.
Complementary in malignant diseases: *Ars; Phos; Sulph*.
*Guaiacol* (is the principal constituent of Kreosote, and similar in action. Used in pulmonary tuberculosis. Dose 1 to 5 m).
*Matico*-Artanthe or Piper augustifolia, (Gonorrhoea, haemorrhage from lungs; catarrhal conditions of genito-urinary organs and gastro-intestinal tract. Topically a haemostatic. Difficult, dry, deep, winter cough. Use tincture).
Compare also: *Fuligo ligni; Carbol ac; Iod; Laches*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to thirtieth potency. The 200th in sensitive patients.

remedies.heading: LAC CANINUM
remedies.intro: This remedy is of undoubted value in certain form of sore throat and diphtheria, and rheumatism. Corresponds to a low-vitiated, non-feverish type of sickness. The keynote symptom is, *erratic pains, alternating sides*. Feels as if walking on air, or of not touching the bed when lying down. Great lassitude. Ozaena. Decided effect in drying up milk in women who cannot nurse the baby. *Great weakness and prostration*. Sinking spells every morning. Mastitis.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Very forgetful; in writing, makes mistakes. *Despondent*; thinks her disease incurable. Attacks of rage. *Visions of snakes*. Thinks himself of little consequence.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Sensation of walking or floating in the air (*Sticta*). Pain first one side, then the other. Blurred vision, nausea and vomiting at height of attack of headache. Occipital pain, with shooting extending to forehead. Sensation as if brain were alternately contracted and relaxed. Noises in ears. Reverberation of voice.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Coryza; one nostril stuffed up, the other free; alternate. Alae nasi and corners of mouth cracked. Bones of nose sore to pressure. Bloody pus discharged.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Tongue coated white with bright red edges; profuse salivation. Drooling in diphtheria. *Cracking of jaw while eating* (*Nit ac; Rhus*). Putrid taste increased by sweets.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Sensitive to touch. Painful swallowing; pain extends to ears. Sore throat and cough with menstruation. *Tonsillitis and diphtheria symptoms change repeatedly from side to side. Shining glazed* appearance of deposit, *pearly-white* or like pure white porcelain. *Stiffness of neck* and tongue. Throat feels burned raw. Tickling sensation causes constant cough. Sore throat beginning and ending with menses.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses too early, profuse, *flow in gushes. Breasts swollen; painful before* (*Calc c; Con; Puls*) and better on appearance of menses. Mastitis; *worse, least jar*. *Helps to dry up milk*. Sinking at epigastrium. Sexual organs easily excited. Backache; spine very sensitive to touch or pressure. *Galactorrhoea*.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Sciatica, right side. Legs feel numb and stiff, cramps in feet. Rheumatic pains in extremities and back, from one side to the other. Pain in arms to fingers. Burning in palms and soles.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Dreams of snakes.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, morning of one day and in the evening of next. *Better*, cold, cold drinks.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Lach; Con; Lac felinum*-Cat's Milk--(ciliary neuralgia; eye symptoms, photophobia; *asthenopia*; dysmenorrhoea); *Lac vaccinum*-Cows' Milk--(headache, rheumatic pains, constipation); *Lac vaccinum coagulatum*-Curds--(nausea of pregnancy); *Lactis vaccini floc*--Cream--(diphtheria, leucorrhoea, menorrhagia, dysphagia); *Lactic ac*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Thirtieth and the highest potencies.

remedies.heading: LAC VACCINUM DEFLORATUM
remedies.intro: A remedy for diseases with faulty nutrition; sick headaches, with profuse flow of urine *during* pain. *Car sickness*.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Despondent. Pain begins in forehead to occiput, in morning on rising. *Intense throbbing*, with nausea, vomiting, blindness, and obstinate constipation; worse, noise, light, motion, during menses, with great prostration, and better by pressure and bandaging head tightly.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: *Constipation*. Stools hard, large, with great straining; painful, lacerating anus.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Colostrum* (Diarrhoea in infants. Whole body smells sour. Colic). *Nat mur*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Sixth, to thirtieth potency and higher.

remedies.heading: LACHESIS MUTUS
remedies.intro: Like all snake poisons, Lachesis decomposes the blood, rendering it more fluid; hence a haemorrhagic tendency is marked. Purpura, septic states, diphtheria, and other low forms of disease, when the system is thoroughly poisoned and the prostration is profound. The modalities are most important in guiding to the remedy. Delirium tremens with much trembling and confusion. Very important during the climacteric and for patients of a melancholic disposition. Ill effects of suppressed discharges. Diphtheritic paralysis (*Botulinum*). Diphtheria carriers. Sensation of tension in various parts. Cannot bear anything tight anywhere.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Great *loquacity*. Amative. Sad in the morning; no desire to mix with the world. Restless and uneasy; does not wish to attend to business; wants to be off somewhere all the time. Jealous (*Hyos*). Mental labor best performed at night. Euthanasia. Suspicious; nightly delusion of fire. Religious insanity (*Verat; Stram*). Derangement of the *time sense*.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Pain through head on awaking. Pain at root of nose. Pressure and burning on vertex. Waves of pain; worse after moving. Sun headaches. With headache, flickerings, dim vision, very pale face. Vertigo. Relieved by onset of a discharge (menses or nasal catarrh).

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Defective vision after diphtheria, extrinsic muscles too weak to maintain focus. Sensation as if eyes were drawn together by cords which were tied in a knot at root of nose.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Tearing pain from zygoma into ear; also with sore throat. Ear-wax hard, dry.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Bleeding, nostrils sensitive. Coryza, preceded by headache. Hay asthma; paroxysms of sneezing (*Silica; Sabad*).

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Pale. Trifacial neuralgia, left side, heat running up into head (*Phos*). Tearing pain in jaw-bones (*Amphisbaena; Phos*). Purple, mottled, puffed; looks swollen, bloated, jaundiced, chlorotic.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Gums swollen, spongy, bleed. Tongue swollen, burns, trembles, red, dry and cracked at tip, catches on teeth. *Aphthous and denuded spots* with burning and rawness. Nauseous taste. *Teeth ache, pain extends to ears*. Pain in facial bones.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Sore, *worse left side, swallowing liquids. Quinsy*. Septic parotiditis. Dry, intensely swollen, externally and internally. Diphtheria; membrane dusky, blackish; *pain aggravated by hot drinks*; chronic sore throat, with much hawking; mucus sticks, *and cannot be forced up or down. Very painful; worse slightest pressure, touch is even more annoying*. In diphtheria, etc, the trouble *began* on the left side. Tonsils purplish. Purple, livid color of throat. Feeling as if something was swollen which must be swallowed; *worse, swallowing saliva or liquids. Pain into ear. Collar and neck-band must be very loose*.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Craving for alcohol, oysters. Any food causes distress. Pit of stomach painful to touch. Hungry, cannot wait for food. Gnawing pressure *made better by eating*, but returning in a few hours. Perceptible trembling movement in the epigastric region. Empty swallowing more painful than swallowing solids.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Liver region sensitive, *cannot bear anything around waist*. Especially suitable to drunkards. Abdomen tympanitic, sensitive, painful (*Bell*).

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Constipated, *offensive* stool. Anus *feels tight*, as if nothing could go through it. Pain darting up the rectum every time be sneezes or coughs. Haemorrhage from bowels like charred straw, *black particles*. Haemorrhoids protrude, become *constricted, purplish*. Stitches in them on sneezing or coughing. Constant urging in rectum, not for stool.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Climacteric troubles, palpitation, flashes of heat, haemorrhages, vertex headache, fainting spells; worse, pressure of clothes. Menses too short, too feeble; *pains all relieved by the flow* (*Eupion*). Left ovary very painful and swollen, indurated. Mammae inflamed, bluish. Coccyx and sacrum pain, especially on *rising* from sitting posture. Acts especially well at beginning and close of menstruation.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Intense excitement of sexual organs.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Upper part of windpipe very susceptible to touch. Sensation of suffocation and strangulation on lying down, particularly *when anything is around throat*; compels patient to spring from bed and rush for open window. Spasm of glottis; feels as if something ran from neck to larynx. Feels *he must take a deep breath*. Cramp-like distress in praecordial region. Cough; dry, suffocative fits, tickling. Little secretion and much sensitiveness; worse, pressure on larynx, *after sleep*, open air. *Breathing almost stops on falling asleep* (*Grind*). Larynx painful to touch. Sensation as of a plug (*Anac*) which moves up and down, with a short cough.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Palpitation, with fainting spells, especially during climacteric. Constricted feeling causing palpitation, with anxiety. Cyanosis. Irregular beats.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Neuralgia of coccyx, *worse rising from sitting posture*; must sit perfectly still. Pain in neck, worse cervical region. Sensation of threads stretched from back to arms, legs, eyes, etc.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Sciatica, right side, better lying down. *Pain in tibia* (may follow sore throat). Shortening of tendons.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Patient *sleeps into an aggravation*. Sudden starting when falling asleep. Sleepiness, yet cannot sleep (*Bell; Op*). Wide-awake in evening.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Chilly in back; feet icy cold; hot flushes and hot perspiration. Paroxysm returns after acids. Intermittent fever every spring.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Hot perspiration, *bluish, purplish appearance*. Boils, carbuncles, ulcers, with bluish, purple surroundings. Dark blisters. Bed-sores, with black edges. Blue-black swellings. Pyemia; dissecting wounds. Purpura, with intense prostration. *Senile erysipelas*. Wens. Cellulitis. Varicose ulcers.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, after sleep, (*Kali bich*). Lachesis sleeps *into* aggravation; ailments that come on during sleep (*Calc*); left side, in the spring, warm bath, pressure or constriction, hot drinks. Closing eyes. *Better*, appearance of discharges, warm applications.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidotes: *Ars; Merc; Heat; Alcohol; Salt*.
Complementary: *Crotalus cascavella* often completes curative work of Lachesis (*Mure; Lycop; Hep; Salamandra*).
Incompatible: *Acet ac; Carb ac*.
Compare: *Cotyledon* (climacteric troubles); *Nat m; Nit ac; Crotal; Amphisboena* -snake lizard--(right jaw swollen and painful, lancinating pains; headaches, lancinating pains. Eruption of vesicles and pimples); *Naja; Lepidium*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Eighth to 200th potency. Doses ought not be repeated too frequently. If well indicated, a single dose should be allowed to exhaust its action.

remedies.heading: LACHNANTHES TINCTORIA
remedies.intro: Head, chest and circulation are affected. Bridge of nose as if pinched. A remedy for torticollis, rheumatic symptoms about neck. *Tuberculosis*-light-complexioned people. Early stages, and established chest cases, with much coldness. Produces a desire to talk-a flow of language and the courage to make a speech.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Right-sided pain, extending down to jaw; *head feels enlarged*; worse, least noise. Scalp painful. Sleepless. Circumscribed red cheeks; scalp feels sore, as if hair was standing on end; burning in palms and soles. Bridge of nose feels as if pinched.

sections.heading: Chest
sections.text: Sensation of heat-bubbling and boiling around heart region rising to head.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: *Chilliness between the shoulder-blades*; pain and stiffness in back.

sections.heading: Neck
sections.text: *Drawn over to one side* in sore throat. Rheumatism of the neck. Stiffness of neck. Pain in nape, as if dislocated.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Body icy cold; face yellow; tendency to sweat.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Dulc; Bry; Puls*; also *Fel tauri* (nape of neck pains, and great tension there).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third potency. Tincture in phthisis, unit doses, once or twice a week, or three drops every four hours.

remedies.heading: LACTICUM ACIDUM
remedies.intro: Morning sickness, *diabetes*, and rheumatism offer a field for this remedy. *Troubles in the breasts*. Locally, in the tuberculous ulceration of vocal cords.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Tongue dry, parched. Thirst; voracious hunger. Canker, *copious salivation and water-brash*. *Nausea*; morning sickness, especially *in pale anaemic* women. Hot, acrid eructation. *Nausea*; better, *eating*. Burning, hot gas from stomach to throat, causing profuse secretion of tenacious mucus, *worse smoking*.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Fullness or lump like a puff ball. Keeps swallowing. Constricted low down.

sections.heading: Chest
sections.text: Pain in breasts, *with enlargement of axillary glands, and pain extends into hand*.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Rheumatic pain in joints and shoulders, wrists, *knees*, with much weakness. Trembling of whole body while walking. Limbs feel chilly.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Large quantities passed, frequently. Saccharine.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Sarcolactic acid q v. Lithia; Phos ac*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to thirtieth potency. Six to ten drops in a small glass of water in acute gastro-enteritis (Cartier).

remedies.heading: LACTUCA VIROSA
remedies.intro: This remedy acts principally upon the brain and circulatory system. Delirium tremens with sleeplessness, coldness, and tremor. Hydrothorax and ascites. Impotence. Sense of lightness and *tightness* affecting whole body, especially chest. Seems to be a *true galactogogue*. Marked action on extremities.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Stupefaction of sense. Great restlessness.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Dull, heavy, confused, dizzy. Heat of face and headache, with general coldness. Headache, with affections of respiratory organs.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Sensation of weight, of fullness; borborygmi; abundant emission of wind. Colic in early morning, abdomen tense, relieved somewhat by evacuation and passing of wind.

sections.heading: Chest
sections.text: Difficult breathing. Suffocative breathing from dropsy of the chest. Constant tickling cough. Incessant, spasmodic cough, as if chest would fly to pieces. Squeezing sensation in lower chest.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Promotes catamenia. *Increase of milk* in breasts (*Asafoet*).

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Restless; impossible to get to sleep. Deep, comatose sleep.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Lame hip down left side; worse walking. Coldness and numbness of feet and legs. Tremor of hands and arms. Cramps in shin bones, extending to toes and side of leg involving calves.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidotes: *Acet ac; Coff*.
Compare: *Nabalus*-Prenanthes Serpentaria-Rattlesnake root-White lettuce, similar to Lactuca, (chronic diarrhoea, worse after eating, nights and towards morning. Pain in abdomen and rectum; emaciation. Constipation and somnolence; susceptible to aura of others. Dyspepsia, with acid burning eructation. *Craving for acid food*. Leucorrhoea with throbbing in uterus); *Lach; Kali carb; Spiranthes* (galactagogue).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture.

remedies.heading: LAMIUM ALBUM
remedies.intro:
Has a special affinity for female and urinary organs.
Headache, *with backward and forward motion of head*. Leucorrhoea and menses too early and scanty. Haemorrhoids; hard stool, with blood. Sensation in urethra as though a drop of water were flowing through it. Tearing in the extremities. Haemoptysis. Blisters on heel from slight rubbing. Ulcers on heel (*Cepa*).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third potency.

remedies.heading: LAPIS ALBUS
remedies.intro:
Affections of glands, *goitre*, pre-ulcerative stage of carcinoma. Burning, stinging pain in breast, stomach, and uterus. Connective tissue about glands specially affected. Fat anaemic babies with Iodine appetite. Ravenous appetite. Remarkably successful in scrofulous affections, except in malarial cases.
*Uterine carcinoma*. Fibroid tumors with *intense burning* pains through the part with *profuse haemorrhage*. Glands have a certain elasticity and pliability about them rather than the stony hardness of *Calc fluor* and *Cistus*.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Otitis media suppurativa. Where Silica is indicated progress is hastened by *Lapis* (Bellows).

sections.heading: Chest
sections.text: Persistent pains in mammary region. Glandular hardening.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Scrofulous abscesses and sores. Enlargement and induration of glands, *especially cervical*. Lipoma, sarcoma, carcinoma. Pruritus.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Silica; Badiaga; Ars iod; Calc iod; Con; Kal iod; Asterias*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to sixth potency.

remedies.heading: LAPPA ARCTIUM
remedies.intro: Very important in skin therapeutics. Eruptions on the head, face, and neck; pimples; acne. Styes and ulcerations on the edge of the eyelids. Profuse and frequent urination. Crops of boils and styes (*Anthracin*).

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Pain in hands, knees, and ankles extending downward to fingers and toes. Pain in all joints. Eruption on extremities.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Uterine displacements. An exceedingly sore, bruised feeling in uterus, with great relaxation of the vaginal tissues; apparently entire lack of tonicity of pelvic contents. These symptoms all aggravated by standing, walking, a misstep, or sudden jar.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.heading: LATHYRUS SATIVUS
remedies.intro: Affects the lateral and anterior columns of the cord. Does not produce pain. *Reflexes always increased*. Paralytic affections of lower extremities; spastic paralysis; lateral sclerosis; Beri-beri. Athetosis. Infantile paralysis. After influenza and wasting, exhaustive diseases where there is much weakness and heaviness, slow recovery of nerve power. Sleepy, constant yawning.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Depressed; hypochondriacal. Vertigo when standing with eyes closed.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Burning pain in *tip of tongue*; with tingling and numbness of tongue and lips, as if scalded.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Tips of fingers numb. Tremulous, tottering gait. Excessive rigidity of legs; spastic gait. Knees knock against each other when walking. Cramps in legs worse cold, and cold feet. Cannot extend or cross legs when sitting. Myelitis, with marked spastic symptoms. Rheumatic paralysis. Gluteal muscles and lower limbs emaciated. Legs blue; swollen, if hanging down. Stiffness and lameness of ankles and knees, toe do not leave the floor, heels do not touch floor, Muscles of calves very tense. Patient sits bent forward, straightens with difficulty.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Increased bladder reflex. Frequent, must hurry, else voided involuntarily.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Oxytrop; Secale; Petiveria*, a South American plant (Paralysis; paraplegia with numbness. Sensation of internal coldness). *Agrostema githago*-Corn-cockle --(Burning sensations, in stomach, through oesophagus into throat, in lower abdomen and anus; nausea, bitter vomiting, impaired locomotion; difficulty in remaining erect; vertigo and *headache, burning from lower jaw to vertex*).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third potency.

remedies.heading: LATRODECTUS MACTANS
remedies.intro: The bite produces tetanic effects that last several days. A picture of *Angina pectoris* is presented by the action of the drug. The praecordial region seems to be the center of attack. Constriction of chest muscles, with radiation to shoulders and back. Lowered coagulability.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Anxiety. Screams with pain. Pain in neck to back of head. Occipital pain.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Extreme apnoea. Gasping respiration. Fears losing breath.

sections.heading: Chest
sections.text: Violent, praecordial pain extending to the axilla and down the arm and forearm to fingers, with numbness of the extremity. Pulse feeble and rapid. Sinking sensation at the Cramping pain from chest to abdomen.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Pain in left arm, feels paralyzed. Weakness of legs followed by cramps in the abdominal muscles. Paraesthesia of lower limbs.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Coldness of whole surface. Skin cold as marble.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Latrodectus Hasselti*-New South Wales Black Spider--(Long lasting effects seem to indicate it as a "*chronic*" blood poisoning. Arrests intense pain in pyaemia. Great oedema in neighborhood of wound; paralysis of limbs, with great wasting of muscles. Violent, darting, burning pains preceding paralysis; vertigo, tendency to fall forward; septicaemic conditions; constant delusion of *flying*. Loss of memory. Roaring noises). *Araena; Mygale; Theridion; Latrodectus Kalipo* -New Zealand spider--(lymphangitis and nervous twitchings, scarlet burning eruption). *Triatema*-Kissing bug --(Swelling with violent itching of fingers and toes. Smothering sensation and difficult breathing succeeded by fainting and rapid pulse).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Sixth potency.

remedies.heading: LAUROCERASUS
remedies.intro: Spasmodic tickling cough, especially in cardiac patients, is often magically influenced by this drug. *Lack of reaction*, especially in chest and heart affections. *Drink rolls audibly through oesophagus and intestines*. General coldness, not ameliorated by warmth. Violent pain in stomach with loss of speech. Spasm of facial muscles and oesophagus. Asphyxia neonatorum.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Coldness; chills and heat alternate. Thirst, with dry mouth in afternoon.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Cyanosis and dyspnoea; worse, sitting up. Patient puts hands on heart. Cough, with valvular disease. Exercise causes pain around heart. Tickling, *dry cough*. Dyspnoea. Constriction of chest. Cough, with copious, jelly-like, or bloody expectoration. Small and feeble pulse. Threatening paralysis of lungs. *Gasping for breath*; clutches at heart.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Mitral regurgitation. Clutching at heart and palpitation. Cyanosis neonatorum.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Spells of deep sleep, with snoring and stertorous breathing.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Toe and finger nails become knotty. Skin blue. Sprained pains in hips, thighs and heels. Cold, clammy feet and legs. Clubbing of fingers. Veins of hands distended.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Hydrocy ac; Camphor; Secale; Ammon carb; Ambra*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture to third potency. Cherry-laurel water, two to five drop doses.

remedies.heading: LECITHINUM
remedies.commonName: A Phosphorus-containing Complex Organic Body prepared from the yolk of egg and animal brains
remedies.intro:
(LECITHIN)
Lecithin is important in the vital processes of plant and animal organisms. Lecithin has a favorable influence upon the nutritive condition and especially upon the blood hence its use in anaemia and convalescence, neurasthenia and insomnia. Increasing the number of red corpuscles and amount of hemoglobin. Excellent galactagog, renders milk more nourishing and increases quantity.
Causes an immediate decrease in the excretion of the phosphates. Mental exhaustion and impotency. Tuberculosis, causing marked improvement in nutrition and general improvement. Tired, weak, short breath, loss of flesh; symptoms of general break-down. Sexually weak.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Forgetful, dull, confused.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Aching, especially in occiput-pulsating and ringing in ears. Pain in zygoma; face pale.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Loss of appetite, thirsty, craves wine and coffee; bloated, sore pain in stomach rising toward throat.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Scanty, with phosphates, sugar or albumen.

sections.heading: Sexual
sections.text: Male power lost or enfeebled. Anaphrodisia and ovarian insufficiency.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Soreness, aching, lack of energy. Tired and weak.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Phosphor*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: One-half to 2 grains of crude and potencies. Twelfth potency.

remedies.heading: LEDUM PALUSTRE
remedies.intro: Affects especially the rheumatic diathesis, going through all the changes, from functional pain to altered secretions and deposits of solid, earthy matter in the tissues. The Ledum rheumatism begins in feet, and travels upward. It affects also the skin, producing an eruption like Poison-oak, and is antidotal thereto, as well as to stings of insects. *There is a general lack of animal heat*, and yet heat of bed is intolerable. For punctured wounds, produced by sharp-pointed instruments or bites particularly if the *wounded parts are cold*, this is the remedy. Tetanus with twitching of muscles near wound.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Vertigo when walking, with tendency to fall to one side. Distress when head is covered. Nosebleed (*Mellilot; Bry*).

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Aching in eyes. Extravasation of blood in lids, conjunctiva, aqueous or vitreous. Contused wounds. Cataract with gout.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: *Red pimples on forehead and cheeks*; stinging when touched. Crusty eruption around nose and mouth.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Dry, retching with eructation. Musty taste with catarrhal affection.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Burning in nose. Cough, with bloody expectoration. Dyspnoea; chest feels constricted. Suffocative arrest of breathing. Pain along trachea. Bronchitis with emphysema of aged. Oppressive constriction of chest. Tickling in larynx; spasmodic cough. Haemoptysis, alternating with rheumatism. Chest hurts when touched. Whooping-cough; spasmodic, *double inspiration* with sobbing.

sections.heading: Rectum
sections.text: *Anal fissures*. Haemorrhoidal pain.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Gouty pains shoot all through the foot and limb, and in joints, but especially small joints. Swollen, hot, pale. Throbbing in right shoulder. Pressure in shoulder, worse motion. Cracking in joints; worse, warmth of bed. Gouty nodosities. Ball of great to swollen (*Bothrops*). Rheumatism begins in lower limbs and ascends (*Kalmia* opposite). Ankles swollen. *Soles painful*, can hardly step on them (*Ant c; Lyc*). Easy spraining of ankle.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Coldness, want of animal heat. Sensation as of cold water over parts; general coldness with heat of face.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Acne on forehead, sticking pain therein. Eczema (facial). Itching of feet and ankles; worse, scratching and warmth of bed. Ecchymosis. Long discoloration after injuries. *Carbuncles* (*Anthracin. Tarant cuben*). *Antidote to Rhus poisoning* (*Grindel; Cyprip; Anac*).

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Better*, from cold, putting feet in cold water. *Worse*, at night, and from heat of bed.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: Ledum antidotes spider poisons. *Ruta; Ham; Bellis; Arnica*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.heading: LEMNA MINOR
remedies.intro: A catarrhal remedy. Acts especially upon the nostrils. *Nasal polypi; swollen turbinates. Atrophic rhinitis*. Asthma from nasal obstruction; worse in wet weather.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: *Putrid smell*; loss of smell. Crusts and muco-purulent discharge very abundant. Post-nasal dropping. Pain like a string from nostrils to ear. Reduces nasal obstruction when it is an oedematous condition. Dryness of naso-pharynx.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: *Putrid taste* on rising in the morning. Dry pharynx and larynx.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Disposition to noisy diarrhoea.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, in damp, rainy weather, especially *heavy rains*.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Dulc* (damp surroundings and foggy weather). *Calc; Teucr; Calend; Nat sulph*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.heading: LEPIDIUM BONARIENSE
remedies.intro:
Affections of breast, heart, lancinating pains.
With heart symptoms, numbness and pain in left arm, sensation of sinking in pit of stomach.
Left side of head, face, chest, hip to knee, all have lancinating pain.
A streak of pain from the temple to the chin, as if the face were cut with a razor. Burning in throat, roaring in ears. Sensation of a tight girdle around chest, as of a knife piercing the heart. Pain in neck, back, and extremities. Compare: *Arnica; Lachesis*.

remedies.heading: LEPTANDRA VIRGINICA
remedies.intro: A liver remedy, with jaundice and *black, tarry stools*. Bilious states. Enfeebled portal circulation. Malarial conditions.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Dull frontal pain; vertigo, drowsiness, and depression. Smarting and aching in eyes.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Tongue coated *yellow*. Great distress in stomach and intestines, with desire for stool. Aching in region of liver extending to spine, which feels chilly.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Profuse *black, fetid stools*, with pain at umbilicus. Bleeding piles. Typhoid stools turn black and look like tar. Clay colored stools with jaundice. Prolapse of rectum with haemorrhoids. Rectal haemorrhage.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Podop; Iris; Bry; Merc; Ptel; Myrica*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.heading: LIATRIS SPICATA
remedies.intro:
A vascular stimulant. Increases functional activity of the skin, mucous membranes.
Of use in dropsy due to liver and spleen diseases, also renal dropsy. Here the suppressed urination is most favorably influenced. *General anasarca* due to heart and kidney disease. *Diarrhoea* with violent urging and pain in lower part of back. Colic. Locally, applied to ulcers and unhealthy wounds.
A prompt diuretic.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: 1 to 4 drams of tincture of infusion.

remedies.heading: LILIUM TIGRINUM
remedies.intro: Manifests powerful influence over the pelvic organs, and is adapted to many reflex states dependent on some pathological condition of uterus and ovaries. More often indicated in unmarried women. The action of the heart is very marked. Pain in small spots (*Oxal ac*). Rheumatic arthritis.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Tormented about her salvation. Consolation aggravates. *Profound depression of spirits*. Constant inclination to weep. Anxious; *fears some organic and incurable disease*. Disposed to curse, strike, think obscene things. *Aimless, hurried manner;* must keep busy.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Hot, dull, heavy. Faint in warm room. Wild feeling in head.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Hyperaesthesia of retina. Pain, extending back into head; lachrymation; and impaired vision. *Myopic astigmia*. Useful in restoring power to the weakened ciliary muscle (*Arg nit*).

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Flatulent; nausea, with sensation of lump in stomach. Hungry; longs for meat. Thirsty, drinks often and much, and before severe symptoms.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Abdomen sore, distended; trembling sensation in abdomen. Pressure downwards and backwards against rectum and anus; worse, standing; better, walking in open air. Bearing down in lower part of abdomen.

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: Frequent urging. Urine milky, scanty, *hot*.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Constant desire to defecate, *from pressure in rectum*, worse standing. Pressure down the anus. Early-morning urgent stool. Dysentery; mucus and blood, with tenesmus, especially in plethoric and nervous women at change of life.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Sensation as if heart were grasped in a vise (*Cact*). Feels full to bursting. Pulsations over whole body. Palpitation; irregular pulse; very rapid. Pain in cardiac region, with feeling of a load on chest. Cold feeling about heart. Suffocating feeling in a crowded and warm room. Angina pectoris with pain in right arm.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses early, scanty, *dark, clotted, offensive; flow only when moving about. Bearing down sensation with urgent desire for stool, as though all organs would escape. Ceases when resting* (*Sep; Lac c; Bell*). *Congestion of uterus*, prolapse, and anteversion. Constant desire to support parts externally. Pain in ovaries and down thighs. Acrid, brown leucorrhoea; smarting in labia. Sexual instinct awakened. Bloated feeling in uterine region. Sub-involution. Pruritus pudendi.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Cannot walk on uneven ground. Pain in back and spine, with trembling, but oftener in front of a pressing-down character. Pricking in fingers. Pain in right arm and hip. Legs ache; cannot keep them still. Pain in ankle joint. Burning palms and soles.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Unrefreshing, with disagreeable dreams. Unable to sleep, with wild feeling in head.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Great heat and lassitude in afternoon, with throbbing throughout body.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse* consolation, warm room. *Better*, fresh air.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: *Cact; Helon; Murex; Sep; Plat; Pallad*.
Antidote: *Helon*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: The middle and higher potencies seem to have done best. Its curative action sometimes is slow in developing itself.

remedies.heading: LIMULUS CYCLOPS
remedies.intro:
Limulus was introduced by C. Hering and partially proved by him and Lippe. Hering was surprised to see the blood of the King-crab that he dissected, blue, which on investigation, was found to contain copper as he had surmised and which he thought would prove to be another medicine for Cholera. Further provings are necessary to establish this, though symptoms so far observed make this probable. Hering's fertile mind always lead him to pioneer paths into practical therapeutics.
Bodily and mental exhaustion; drowsiness *after sea bathing*. Gastro-enteric symptoms. Painful fullness of whole right side of body.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Mental depression. Difficult to remember names, confused with heat of face, rush of blood to face, worse when meditating. Pain behind left eye-ball.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Fluent coryza. Sneezing worse drinking water. Constant nasal dropping. Pressure above nose and behind eyes.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Colic with heat. Cramp-like pain with watery stools. Abdomen hot and constricted. Piles, constriction of anus.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Husky voice. Dyspnoea after drinking water. Oppression of chest.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Crural neuralgia. Soles of feet ache, feel numb. Pain in right hip-joint. Heels sore.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: *Itching spots and vesicles* on face *and hands*. Burning in palms.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Asterias; Homarus; Cuprum*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Sixth potency.

remedies.heading: LINARIA VULGARIS
remedies.intro: Acts prominently within the domain of the pneumogastrics. Eructations, nausea, salivation, pressure on stomach. Jaundice, splenic and hepatic hypertrophy. Enteric symptoms and *great drowsiness* very marked. Cardiac *fainting*. Enuresis. Rectal symptoms. Tongue rough, dry; throat constricted. Coldness. Confusion in head. Irresistible sleepiness. Symptoms worse walking in open air.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third potency.

remedies.heading: LINUM USITATISSIMUM
remedies.intro: The application of Linseed poultice has produced in sensitive subjects severe respiratory disturbances, as asthma, hives, etc. Its action in such cases is marked by *intense irritation*. It has been found to contain small quantity of Hydrocyanic acid, which may account for this intensity. The decoction is of service in inflammation of the urinary passages, cystitis, strangury, etc. Also in diseases of the intestinal tract. It has a place in the treatment of asthma, hay-fever and urticaria. Trismus and paralysis of the tongue.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Linum Catharticum*-Purging flax --(Similar respiratory symptoms, but also colic and diarrhoea).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Lower potencies.

remedies.heading: LITHIUM CARBONICUM
remedies.intro: Chronic *rheumatism connected with heart lesions* and asthenopia offer a field for this remedy. Rheumatic nodes. Uric acid diathesis Whole body is *sore*. Gout and tophi.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Tension, as if bound; better, sitting and going out. Externally sensitive. *Headache ceases while eating*. Trembling and throbbing. Pain in heart; extends to head. Dizzy states with ringing in ears. Both cheeks covered with dry, bran-like scales.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Half vision; invisible right half. Photophobia. Pain over eyes. Dry lids. Eyes pain after reading.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Acidity, nausea, *gnawing, relieved by eating* (*Anacard*). Cannot endure slightest pressure of clothes (*Laches*).

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Tenesmus. Turbid urine, with mucus and red deposit. Pain in region of right kidney. Free and colorless. While urinating, pressure in heart. Cystitis, subacute and chronic.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Constriction of chest. Violent cough when lying down. Air feels cold when inspired. Pain in mammary glands, *which extend into the arms and fingers*.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Rheumatic soreness in cardiac region. Sudden shock in heart. Throbbing, dull stitch in cardiac region. Pains in heart before menses, and associated with pains in bladder, and before urinating; better, after. Trembling and fluttering in heart, extending to back.

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: Soreness of bladder; pain in right kidney and ureter. Turbid urine with mucus, scanty and dark, acrid; sandy deposit.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Paralytic stiffness all over. Itching about joints. Rheumatic pains throughout shoulder-joint, arm, and fingers and small joints generally. Pain in hollow of foot, extending to knee. Swelling and tenderness of finger and toe joints; better, hot water. Nodular swellings in joints. Ankles pain when walking.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Scabby, tettery eruption on hands, head, and cheeks, preceded by red, raw skin. Dull stitch, ending in itching. *Barber's itch* (use high). Rough rash all over body, much loose epithelium, tough, dry, itchy skin.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, in morning, right side. *Better*, rising and moving about.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Lyc; Ammon phos; Benz ac; Calc; Lithium chlor* (symptoms of cinchonism, viz.: *Dizzy* head, full, *bluring of vision* Ringing in ears; marked tremors; *general weakness*; marked muscular and general prostration; no gastro-intestinal effects. Nose sore, heartburn, pain in teeth). *Lithium lacticum* (rheumatism of shoulder, and small joints relieved by moving about; worse, resting). *Lithium benzoicum* (deep-seated pains in loins; in small of back; uneasiness in bladder. Cystic irritation. Gallstones. Frequent desire. Diminishing uric acid deposit). *Lithium bromatum* (cerebral congestion, threatened apoplexy, insomnia and epilepsy).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to third trituration.

remedies.heading: LOBELIA INFLATA
remedies.intro:
Is a vaso-motor stimulant; increases the activity of all vegetative processes; spends its force mainly upon the pneumogastric nerve, producing a depressed relaxed condition with oppression of the chest and epigastrium, impeded respiration, nausea and vomiting.
Languor, relaxation of muscles, *nausea, vomiting and dyspepsia* are the general indications that point to the use of this remedy, in asthma and gastric affections. Best adapted to light complexioned fleshy people. Bad effects of drunkenness. *Suppressed discharges* (*Sulph*). Diphtheria. *Catarrhal jaundice* (*Chionanth*).

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Vertigo, and fear of death. Gastric headache, with nausea, vomiting, and great prostration; worse, afternoon until midnight; tobacco. Dull, heavy pain.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Bathed in cold sweat. Sudden pallor.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: *Deafness due to suppressed discharges* or eczema. Shooting pain from throat.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Profuse flow of saliva; acrid burning taste; *mercurial taste*; tenacious mucus, tongue coated white.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Acidity, flatulence, shortness of breath after eating. Heartburn with profuse flow of saliva. *Extreme nausea and vomiting*. Morning sickness. *Faintness and weakness at epigastrium. Profuse salivation, with good appetite*. Profuse sweat and prostration. Cannot bear smell or taste of tobacco. Acrid, burning taste; acidity, with contractive feeling in pit of stomach. Flatulence, shortness of breath after eating. Heartburn.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: *Dyspnoea from constriction of chest*; worse, any exertion. Sensation of pressure or weight in chest; *better by rapid walking*. Feels as if heart would stop. Asthma; attacks, with weakness, felt in pit of stomach and preceded by *prickling* all over. Cramp, ringing cough, short breath, catching at throat. Senile emphysema.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Pain in sacrum; cannot bear slightest touch. Sits leaning forward.

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: Deep red color and copious red sediment.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Prickling, itching with intense nausea.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, tobacco, afternoon, slightest motion, cold, especially cold washing. *Better*, by rapid walking; (chest pain), toward evening, and from warmth.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidote: *Ipec*.
Compare: *Tabac; Ars; Tart e; Verat; Rosa*.
*Lobelia syphilitica or cerulea* (gives a perfect picture of sneezing influenza, involving the posterior nares, palate, and fauces. Very depressed.
