sections.text: Features sunken. *Icy coldness of tip of nose and face*. Nose grows more pointed. Tearing in cheeks, temples, and eyes. *Face very pale, blue, collapsed, cold*.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Tongue pale, cold; cool sensation, as from peppermint. Dry in center not relieved by water. Salty saliva. Toothache, teeth feel heavy as if filled with lead.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: *Voracious* appetite. *Thirst for cold water, but is vomited as soon as swallowed*. Averse to warm food. Hiccough. *Copious vomiting and nausea; aggravated by drinking and least motion*. Craves fruit, juicy and cold things, ice, salt. Anguish in pit of stomach. Great weakness after vomiting. Gastric irritability with *chronic* vomiting of food.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Sinking and empty feeling. *Cold feeling* in stomach and abdomen. Pain in abdomen preceding stool. Cramps, knotting abdomen and legs. Sensation as if hernia would protrude (*Nux*). Abdomen sensitive to pressure, swollen with terrible colic.

sections.heading: Rectum
sections.text: Constipation from inactivity of rectum, with heat and headache. Constipation of babies, and when produced by very cold weather. *Stools large, with much straining until exhausted, with cold sweat*. Diarrhoea, very painful, watery, *copious, and forcibly evacuated*, followed by great prostration. Evacuations of cholera morbus and true cholera when vomiting accompanies the purging.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Hoarse, weak voice. Rattling in chest. Much mucus in bronchial tubes, that cannot be coughed up. Coarse rales. Chronic bronchitis in the aged (*Hippozanin*). Loud barking, stomach cough, followed by eructation of gas; worse, warm room. Hollow cough, tickling low down, with blue face. Cough comes on from drinking, especially cold water; urine escapes when coughing. Cough on entering warm room from cold air (*Bryonia*).

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Palpitation with anxiety and rapid audible respiration. Pulse irregular, feeble. Tobacco heart from chewing. Intermittent action of heart in feeble persons with some hepatic obstruction. One of the best heart stimulants in homeopathic doses (J. S. Mitchell).

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses too early; profuse and exhausting. *Dysmenorrhoea, with coldness*, purging, *cold sweat*. *Faints from least exertion*. Sexual mania precedes menses.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Soreness and tenderness of joints. Sciatica; pains like electric flashes. *Cramps in calves*. Neuralgia in brachial plexus; arms feel swollen, cold, paralytic.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Blue, cold, clammy, inelastic, *cold as death*. Cold sweat. Wrinkling of skin of hands and feet.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Chill, *with extreme coldness* and thirst.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, at night; wet, cold weather. *Better*, walking and warmth.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Veratrinum*-alkaloid from seeds of Sabadilla.--(electric pains, electric shocks in muscles, fibrillary twitchings); *Cholos terrepina* (cramps in calves); *Camph; Cupr; Ars; Cuprum ars* (*intermittent, cold, clammy sweat*); *Narcissus poeticus* (gastro-enteritis with much griping and cutting pain in bowels. Fainting, trembling, cold limbs, small and irregular pulse); *Trychosanthes*--(diarrhoea, pain in liver, dizziness after every stool); *Agaric emetic* (vertigo; longing for ice-cold water; burning pains in stomach); *Agaric phalloides* (cholera, cramps in stomach, cold extremities, urine suppressed). *Veratrine* (Increased vascular tension. It relaxes it and stimulates the elimination of toxins by skin, kidneys, and liver).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to thirtieth potency. In diarrhoea, not below the sixth.

remedies.heading: VERATRUM VIRIDE
remedies.intro: Paroxysms of auricular fibrillation. Induces fall of both systolic and diastolic blood pressure. Congestions, especially to lungs, base of brain, with nausea and vomiting. Twitchings and convulsions. Especially adapted to full-blooded, plethoric persons. Great prostration. Rheumatism of heart. *Bloated, livid face*. Furious delirium. Effects of sunstroke. *OEsophagitis.* (Farrington). *Verat vir*, will raise the opsonic index against the *diploccus pneumonia*, 70 to 109 per cent. Congestive stage and early manifestations of hepatization in pneumonia. Zigzag temperature. Clinically, it is known that such diseases as Tiegel's contracture, Thompson's Disease, athetosis and pseudo-hypertrophic muscular paralysis present a symptomatology quite like that produced by Veratrum vir upon muscular tissue (A. E. Hinsdale, M. D).

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Quarrelsome and delirious.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Congestion intense, almost apoplectic. Hot head, bloodshot eyes. Bloated, livid face. Hippocratic face. Head retracted, *pupils dilated*, double vision. Meningitis. *Pain from nape of neck*; cannot hold head up. Sunstroke; head full, throbbing arteries (*Bell; Glon; Usnea*). *Face flushed*. Convulsive twitching of facial muscles (*Agaricus*). Vertigo with nausea.

sections.heading: Tongue
sections.text: White or yellow, *with red streak down the middle*. Feels scalded. Increased saliva.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Thirsty. Nausea and vomiting. Smallest quantity of food or drink immediately rejected. Constrictive pain; increased by warm drinks. *Hiccough*; excessive and painful, with *spasms of oesophagus*. Burning in stomach and oesophagus.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Pain above pelvis, with soreness.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Congestion of lungs. Difficult breathing. Sensation of a heavy load on chest. Pneumonia, with faint feeling in stomach and violent congestion. *Croup*. Menstrual colic before the appearance of the discharge with strangury.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Scanty with cloudy sediment.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Rigid os (*Bell; Gels*). Puerperal fever. Suppressed menstruation, with congestion to head (*Bell*). Menstrual colic before the appearance of the discharge with strangury.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Pulse *slow, soft, weak*, irregular, intermittent. Rapid pulse, low tension (*Tabac; Dig*). Constant, dull, burning pain in region of heart. Valvular diseases. *Beating of pulses throughout body*, especially in right thigh.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Aching pain in back of neck and shoulders. Severe pain in joints and muscles. Violent electric-like shocks in limbs. Convulsive twitchings. *Acute rheumatism. Fever*.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Erysipelas, with cerebral symptoms. Erythema. Itching in various parts. *Hot sweating*.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Hyperthermy in the evening and hypothermy in the morning. Suppurative fevers with great variation of temperature.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Gels; Bapt; Bell; Acon; Ferr phos*. Antidotes Strychnin-fluid extract, 20-40 drops.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to sixth potency.

remedies.heading: VERBASCUM THAPSUS
remedies.intro: Has a pronounced action on the inferior maxillary branch of the fifth pair of the cranial nerves; on the ear; and respiratory tract and bladder. *Catarrhs*, and colds, *with periodical prosopalgia*. Quiets nervous, and bronchial, and urinary irritation, and cough.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Neuralgia affecting zygoma, temporo maxillary joint, and ear (*Menyanth*), particularly of left side, with lachrymation, coryza, and sensation *as if parts were crushed with tongs*. Talking, sneezing, and change of temperature aggravate the pains; also, pressing teeth together. Pains seem to come in flashes, excited by least movement, occurring periodically at same hour in morning and afternoon each day.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Otalgia, with a sense of obstruction. Deafness. Dry, scaly condition of meatus (use locally).

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Pain extends deep down, causing contraction of sphincter ani.

sections.heading: Rectum
sections.text: Many movements a day, with twisting about navel. Haemorrhoids, with obstructed, hardened stool. Inflamed and painful piles.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: *Hoarse*; voice deep, harsh; sounds like a trumpet; "basso profundo". Cough; worse at night. Asthma. Soreness in pharynx, cough during sleep.

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: Constant dribbling. *Enuresis*. Burning urination. Increase with pressure in bladder.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Cramp-like pain in soles, right foot, and knee. Lower extremities feel heavy. Thumb feels numb. Neuralgic pain in left ankle. Stiffness *and soreness of joints of lower extremities*.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, change of temperature, talking, sneezing, biting hard (inferior dental nerve); from 9 am to 4 pm.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Rhus arom; Caust; Platin; Sphingurus* (pain in zygoma).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: *Mullein oil*, (locally, for earache and dry, scaly condition of meatus. Also for teasing cough at night or lying down. Internally, tincture and lower potencies). *Enuresis*, five-drop doses night and morning.

remedies.heading: VERBENA URTICAEFOLIA
remedies.intro: Affects the skin and *nervous system*. Nervous depression, weakness and irritation and spasms. Promotes the absorption of blood and allays pain in bruises. Vesicular erysipelas. Passive congestion and intermittent fever. One of the remedies for Poison-oak. *Epilepsy*, insomnia, mental exhaustion. In epilepsy, it *brightens up the patient's mental powers* and helps the constipation.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Single dose of the tincture. In epilepsy must be continued for a long time. Verbena in the form of a tea as a diuretic drink is used by Vannier (Paris) to aid elimination in tubercular therapy.

remedies.heading: VESPA CRABRO
remedies.intro:
Skin and female symptoms marked. Indurated feeling. Vasomotor symptoms of skin and mucous membranes.
Dizzy, better lying on back. Fainting. Numbness and blindness. Nausea and vomiting, followed by creeping chills from feet upward. Cramping pain in bowels. Axillary glands swollen with soreness of upper arms. Perspiration on parts laid on with itching.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Painful and swollen. Erysipelatous inflammation of lids. *Chemosis of conjunctiva*. Swelling of mouth and throat, with violent burning pains.

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: *Burning* with micturition; also itching.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text:
Menstruation, preceded by depression, pain, pressure, and constipation. *Left ovary markedly affected*, with *frequent burning, micturition*; sacral pains extending up back.
*Erosion around external os*.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Erythema; *intense itching*; burning. *Boils*; stinging and soreness, relieved by bathing with vinegar. Wheals, macules and swellings with burning, stinging and soreness. Erythema multiforme, *relieved* by bathing with vinegar.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: *Scorpio* (salivation; strabismus; tetanus); *Apis*.
Antidote: *Sempervivum tector*, locally.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Third to thirtieth potency.

remedies.heading: VIBURNUM OPULUS
remedies.intro: A general remedy for cramps. Colicky pains in pelvic organs. Superconscious of internal sexual organs. Female symptoms most important. *Often prevents miscarriage*. False labor-pains. Spasmodic and congestive affections, dependent upon ovarian or uterine origin.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Irritable. Vertigo; feels as if falling forward. Severe pain in temporal region. Sore feeling in eyeballs.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Constant nausea; relieved by eating. No appetite.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: *Sudden cramps and colic pains*. Tender to pressure about umbilicus.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses *too late, scanty, lasting a few hours*, offensive in odor, with crampy pains, cramps extend down thighs (*Bell*). Bearing-down pains before. Ovarian region feels heavy and congested. Aching in sacrum and pubes, with pain in anterior muscles of thighs (*Xanthox*); *spasmodic and membranous dysmenorrhoea* (*Borax*). Leucorrhoea, excoriating. Smarting and itching of genitals. Faint on attempting to sit up. *Frequent and very early miscarriage*, causing seeming sterility. Pains from back to loins and womb worse early morning.

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: Frequent urging. Copious, pale, light-colored urine. Cannot hold water on coughing or walking.

sections.heading: Rectum
sections.text: Stools large and hard, with cutting in rectum and soreness of anus.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Stiff, sore feeling in nape of neck. Feels as if back would break. Sacral backache. Lower extremities weak and heavy.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, lying on affected side, in warm room, evening and night. *Better*, in open air and resting.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Virburnum prunifolium*-Black Haw--(habitual miscarriage; *after-pains*; cancer of the tongue; obstinate hiccough; supposed to be a uterine tonic. Morning sickness; menstrual irregularities of sterile females with uterine displacements). *Cimicif; Cauloph; Sep; Xanthox*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture, and lower potencies.

remedies.heading: VINCA MINOR
remedies.intro: A remedy for skin affections, eczema, and especially plica polonica; also for haemorrhages and diphtheria.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Tearing pain in vertex, ringing and whistling in ears. Whirling vertigo, with flickering before eyes. *Spots on scalp, oozing moisture, matting hair together. Corrosive itching of scalp*. Bald spots. *Plica polonica*. Irresistible desire to scratch.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Tip gets red easily. Moist eruption on septum. Stoppage of one nostril. *Sores in nose*. Seborrhoea upper lip and base of nose.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Difficult swallowing. Ulcers. Frequent hawking. *Diphtheria*.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Excessive menstruation with great weakness. *Passive uterine haemorrhages* (*Ust; Trill; Secale*). Menorrhagia; continuous flow, particularly at climacteric (*Lach*). Haemorrhages from fibroids.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Corrosive itching. *Great sensitiveness of skin, with redness and soreness* from slight rubbing. Eczema of head and face; pustules, itching, burning, and offensive odor. Hair matted together.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Oleand; Staph*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to third potency.

remedies.heading: VIOLA ODORATA
remedies.intro: Has a specific action on the ear. Affects especially dark-haired patients; supra-orbital and orbital regions; rheumatism in upper parts of the body when on the *right* side. *Worm affections* in children (*Teuc*). Locally, for pain due to uterine fibroids. Also against snake-bites, bee-stings. *Tension* extends to upper half of face and ears.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: *Burning of the forehead*. Vertigo; everything in head seems to whirl around. Heaviness of head, with sensation of weakness in muscles of nape of neck. *Scalp tense; must knit the brows. Tendency to pain immediately above eyebrows*. Throbbing under eye and temple. *Headache across the forehead*. Acts upon frontal sinuses. Hysterical attacks in tuberculous patients.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Heaviness of lids. Eyeball feels compressed. Flames before eyes. Myopia. Choroiditis. Illusions of vision; fiery, serpentine circles.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Shooting in ears. Aversion to music. Roaring and tickling. Deep stitches beneath ears. Deafness; *otorrhoea*. Ear affections with pain in eyeballs.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Torpor in the end of nose, as from a blow. Dry, short, spasmodic cough and dyspnoea; worse in daytime. Oppression of chest. Pertussis, with hoarseness. *Dyspnoea during pregnancy*. Difficult breathing, anxiety and palpitation, with hysteria.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Rheumatism of the deltoid muscle. Trembling of limbs. *Pressing pain in right carpal and metacarpal joints.* (*Ulmus*).

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: *Milky urine*; smells strong. Enuresis in nervous children.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, cool air.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Ulmus* (formication in feet, numb, creeping pain in legs and feet; rheumatic pains above wrists; numbness, tingling, and full soreness where gastrocnemius gives off its tendon); *Chenopodium* (*ears; serous or bloody effusion in the labyrinth*; chronic otitis media; progressive *deafness to the voice, but sensitive to sounds* of passing vehicles and other sounds; buzzing; absent or deficient bone conduction; a consciousness of the ear; hearing better for shrill, high-pitched sounds than for low ones); *Aur; Puls; Sep; Ign; Cina; Cauloph* (in rheumatism of small joints).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to sixth potency.

remedies.heading: VIOLA TRICOLOR
remedies.intro: The principal uses of this remedy are for eczema in childhood and nocturnal emission accompanied by very vivid dreams.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Heavy, pressing-outward pain. Eczema of scalp, with swollen glands. Face hot and sweating after eating.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Much phlegm, causing hawking; worse in the air. Swallowing difficult.

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: Copious; disagreeable, cat-like odor.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Swelling of prepuce, burning in glans. Itching. Involuntary, seminal emissions at stool.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: *Impetigo*. Intolerable itching. Eruptions, particularly over face and head, with burning, itching; worse at night. Thick scabs, which crack and exude a tenacious yellow pus. Eczema impetigonoides of the face. Sycosis.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, winter; 11 am. Compare: *Lycop*.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Rhus; Calc; Sepia*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Lower potencies.

remedies.heading: VIPERA BERUS
remedies.intro:
Viper poisoning causes a temporary increase in reflexes, paresis supervenes, a paraplegia of the lower extremities extending upwards. Resembles acute ascending paralysis of Landry (Wells). Has special action on kidneys and induces haematuria. Cardiac dropsy.
Indicated in inflammation of veins with great swelling; *bursting sensation. Enlargement of liver*. Ailments of menopause. OEdema of glottis. Poly-neuritis, polio-myelitis.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Excessively swollen. Lips and tongue swollen, livid, protruding. Tongue dry, brown, black. Speech difficult.

sections.heading: Liver
sections.text: Violent pain in enlarged liver, with jaundice and fever; extends to shoulder and hip.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text:
Patient is obliged to keep the extremities elevated. *When they are allowed to hang down, it seems as if they would burst, and the pain is unbearable* (*Diad*).
*Varicose veins* and acute phlebitis. Veins swollen, sensitive; bursting pain. Severe cramps in lower extremities.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Livid. Skin peels in large plates. Lymphangioma, boils, carbuncles, with *bursting* sensation, relieved by elevating parts.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: *Pelius berus*-Adder (Prostration and fainting, faltering pulse, skin yellow, *pain about navel*. Swelling of arm, tongue, right eye; giddiness, nervousness, faintness, sickness, compression of chest, could not breathe properly or take a deep breath; aching and stiffness of limbs, joints stiff, collapsed feeling, great thirst). *Eel serum* (heart and kidney diseases. Failure of compensation and impending asystole).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Twelfth potency.

remedies.heading: VISCUM ALBUM
remedies.intro:
Lowered blood pressure. Dilated blood vessels but does not act on the centers in the medulla. Pulse is slow due to central irritation of the vagus.
The symptoms point especially to rheumatic and gouty complaints; neuralgia, especially sciatica. Epilepsy, *chorea*, and metrorrhagia. *Rheumatic deafness. Asthma*. Spinal pains, due to uterine causes. Rheumatism with *tearing pains*. Hypertensive albuminuria. Valvular disease, with disturbances in sexual sphere. Symptoms like epileptic aura and petit mal.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Feeling as if whole vault of skull were lifted up. Blue ring around eyes. Double vision. Buzzing and stopped-up feeling in ear. Deafness from cold. Facial muscles in constant agitation. Persistent vertigo.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Dyspnoea; *feeling of suffocation when lying on left side*. Spasmodic cough. *Asthma*, if connected with gout or rheumatism. Stertorous breathing.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Haemorrhage, with pain; blood partly clots and bright red. Climacteric complaints (*Lach; Sulph*). Pain from sacrum into pelvis, with tearing, shooting pains from above downwards. Retained placenta (*Secale*). Chronic endometritis. Metrorrhagia. Ovaralgia, especially left.

sections.heading: Heart
sections.text: Hypertrophy with valvular insufficiency; pulse small and weak; unable to rest in a reclining position. Palpitation during coitus. Low tension. Failing compensation, dyspnoea worse lying on left side. Weight and oppression of heart; as if a hand were squeezing it; tickling sensation about heart.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Pains alternate in the knee and ankle with shoulder and elbow. *Sciatica. Tearing*, shooting pains in both thighs and upper extremities. A *glow* rises from the feet to the head; seems to be on fire. Periodic pains from sacrum into pelvis, *worse in bed*, with pains into thighs and upper extremities. General tremor, as if all muscles were in state of fibrillary contraction. Dropsy of extremities. Sensation of a spider crawling over back of hand and foot. Itching all over. Compressing pain in feet.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, winter, cold, stormy weather; in bed. Movement; lying on left side.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Secale: Convallar; Bry; Puls; Rhodod. Guipsine* -active principle--(exalts the hypotensive properties of Viscum). *Hedera Helix*-Ivy--(Intercranial pressure).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture and lower potencies.

remedies.heading: WYETHIA HELENOIDES
remedies.intro: Has marked effects on the throat, and has proven an excellent remedy in *pharyngitis*, especially the follicular form. Irritable throats of singers and public speakers. Useful also in haemorrhoids. Hay-fever symptoms; *itching in posterior nares*.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Nervous, uneasy, depressed. Dizzy. Rush of blood to head. Sharp pain in forehead.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Feels as if scalded; sensation of heat down oesophagus. Itching of the palate.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Constant clearing and hemming. *Dry*, posterior nares; no relief from clearing. *Throat feels swollen*; epiglottis dry and burning. Difficult swallowing. Constant desire to swallow saliva. Uvula feels elongated.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Sense of weight. Belching of wind alternating with hiccough. Nausea and vomiting.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Pain below ribs of right side.

sections.heading: Stool
sections.text: Loose, dark, at night. Itching of anus. Constipation, *with haemorrhoids*; not bleeding.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Dry, *hacking cough*, caused by tickling of the epiglottis. Burning sensation in the bronchial tubes. Tendency to get hoarse talking or singing; throat hot, dry. Dry asthma.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Pain in left ovary, shooting down to knee. Pain in uterus; could outline its contour.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Pain in back; extends to end of spine. Pain right arm, stiffness of wrist and hand. Aching pains all over.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Chill at 11 am. Thirst for ice-water during chill. No thirst with heat. Profuse sweat all night. Terrific headache during sweat.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Arum; Sang; Lach*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to sixth potency.

remedies.heading: X-RAY
remedies.commonName: Vial containing alcohol exposed to X-Ray
remedies.intro:
Repeated exposure to Roentgen (*X-ray*) has produced skin lesions often followed by cancer. Distressing pain. Sexual glands are particularly affected. Atrophy of ovaries and testicles. Sterility. Changes take place in the blood lymphatics and bone marrow. Anaemia and leukaemia. Corresponds to stubbornness as in burns, they refuse to heal. Psoriasis.
Has the property of stimulating cellular metabolism. Arouses the reactive vitality, mentally and physically. Brings to the surface suppressed symptoms, especially sycotic and those due to mixed infections. Its homeopathic action is thus centrifugal, towards the periphery.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Sticking pains in different parts of head and face. Dull pain in right upper jaw. Stiff neck. Sudden cricks in neck, pains more severe behind ears. Pain in muscles of neck when lifting head from pillow. Fullness in ears, ringing in head.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Tongue dry, rough, sore. Throat painful on swallowing. Nausea.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Lewd dreams. Sexual desire lost. Re-establishes suppressed gonorrhoea.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Rheumatic pains. General tired and sick feeling. Palms rough and scaly.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Dry, itching eczema. Erythema around roots of nails. Skin dry, wrinkled. Painful cracks. Warty growths. Nails thicken. Psoriasis.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, in bed, afternoon, evening and night; open air.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text:
Twelfth potency and higher.
Compare: *Electricitas*.--Sugar of milk saturated with the current (Anxiety, nervous tremors, restlessness, palpitation, headaches. Dreads approach of thunder-storms; heaviness of limbs).
*Magnetis Poli Ambo*.--The Magnet.--Sugar of milk or distilled water exposed to influence of entire mass (Burning lancinations throughout the body; pains as if broken in joints, when cartilages of two bones touch; shooting and jerkings; headache as if a nail were driven in; tendency of old wounds to bleed afresh).
*Magnetis Polus Arcticus*.--North pole of the magnet.--(Disturbed sleep, somnambulism, cracking in cervical vertebrae, sensation of coldness; toothache).
*Magnetis Polus Australis*.--South pole of the magnet.--(Severe pain in inner side of nail of the big toe, *ingrowing toenail*; easy dislocation of joints of foot; feet are painful when letting them hang down).

remedies.heading: XANTOXYLUM FRAXINEUM
remedies.intro: Its specific action is on the nervous system and mucous membranes. Paralysis, especially *hemiplegia*. Painful haemorrhages, after-pains, *neuralgic dysmenorrhoea*, and rheumatic affections, offer a therapeutic field for this remedy, especially in patients of spare habit and nervous, delicate organization. Indigestion from over-eating or from too much fluid. Sluggish capillary circulation. Neurasthenia, poor assimilation, insomnia, occipital headache. Increases mucous secretion of mouth and stimulates the secretion from all glands with ducts opening in the mouth.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Nervous, frightened. Mental depression.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Feels full. Weight and pain on vertex. Pain over eyes, throbbing pressure over nose, pressure in forehead; head seems divided; ringing in ears. Occipital headache. Sick headache with dizziness and flatulence.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Neuralgia of lower jaw. Dryness of mouth and fauces. Pharyngitis (*Wyethia*).

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Griping and diarrhoea. Dysentery, with *tympanites*, tenesmus; inodorous discharges.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Menses too early and painful. Ovarian neuralgia, with pain in loins and lower abdomen; worse, *left side*, extending down the thigh, along genito-crural nerves. *Neuralgic dysmenorrhoea*, with neuralgic headaches; *pain in back and down legs*. Menses thick, almost black. *After-pains* (*Arnica; Cup; Cham*). Leucorrhoea at time of menses. Neurasthenic patients who are thin, emaciated; poor assimilation with insomnia and occipital headache.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Aphonia. Constant desire to take a long breath; oppression of chest. Dry cough, day and night.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Paralysis of left side following spinal disorders. Numbness of left side; impairment of nerves of motion. Hemiplegia. Pain in nape, extending down back. Sciatica; worse, hot weather. Anterior, crural neuralgia (*Staph*). Left arm numb. Neuralgic shooting pain, as from electricity, all over limb.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Hard and unrefreshing; dreams of flying. Sleeplessness in neurasthenics.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Gnaph; Cimicif; Staph; Mezer; Piscidia*-White dogwood--(a nerve sedative. *Insomnia due* to worry, nervous excitement, spasmodic coughs; pains of irregular menstruation; regulates the flow. Neuralgic and spasmodic affections. Use tincture in rather material doses).

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to sixth potency.

remedies.heading: XEROPHYLLUM
remedies.intro: Should prove curative in eczematous conditions, poison-oak, early typhoid states, etc.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text:
Dull, cannot concentrate mind for study; forgets names;
*writes last letters of words first*; misspells common words.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Feels full, stuffed up, pain across forehead and above eyes. Great pressure at root of nose. Bewildered. Loss of consciousness. Pulsating headache.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Painful, as of sand, smarting; difficult to focus for close work. Eyes feel sore, burn.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Stuffed; tightness at bridge of nose; acute nasal catarrh.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Bloated in morning. Puffy under eyes.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Stitching pain upon swallowing.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Feels full and heavy. Eructations sour; offensive, an hour after luncheon and dinner. Vomiting at 2 pm.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Intestinal flatulence. In morning rumbling in bowels, with desire for stool.

sections.heading: Rectum
sections.text: Constipation, stools hard, small lumps. Difficult, soft stools, with much straining. Much flatus. Bearing-down pain in rectum.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Difficulty of retaining; dribbling when walking. Frequent urination at night.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Bearing-down sensation. Vulva inflamed, with furious itching. Increased sexual desire, with ovarian and uterine pains and leucorrhoea.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Posterior nares raw; discharge thick, yellow mucus. Sneezing. Trachea sore; lumps feel constricted.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Feels hot from sacrum to scapulae. Backache, extending down legs. Pain over kidneys. Heat deep in spine.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Muscular lameness, trembling. Pain in knees. Limbs feel stiff (*Rhus*).

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Erythema, with vesication and intense itching, stinging, and burning. Blisters, little lumps. Skin rough and cracked; feels like leather. Dermatitis, especially around knees. Inflammation resembling poison-oak. Inguinal glands and behind knee swollen.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, application of cold water, in afternoon and evening. *Better*, application of hot water, in morning, moving affected part.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Rhus; Anacard; Grindelia*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Sixth potency or higher.

remedies.heading: YOHIMBINUM
remedies.intro: Excites sexual organs and acts on central nervous system and respiratory center. An aphrodisiac, used in physiological doses, but contraindicated in all acute and chronic inflammations of abdominal organs. Homeopathically, should be of service in congestive conditions of the sexual organs. Causes hyperaemia of the milk glands and stimulates the function of lactation. Menorrhagia.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Agitation, with flying sensations of heat in face. Disagreeable, metallic taste. Copious salivation. Nausea and eructation.

sections.heading: Sexual
sections.text: *Strong and lasting erections*. Neurasthenic impotence. Bleeding piles. Intestinal haemorrhage. Urethritis.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Rigor; intense heat, waves of heat and chilliness, tendency to sweat.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: *Sleepless*. Thoughts of events of whole past life keep him awake.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: As a sexual stimulant, ten drops of a one per cent solution, or hypodermic tablets of 0. 005 gm. Homeopathic dose, third potency.

remedies.heading: YUCCA FILAMENTOSA
remedies.intro: So-called bilious symptoms, with headache. Despondent and irritable.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Aches as if top of head would fly off. Arteries of forehead throb. Nose red.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: Yellow; tongue yellow, coated, taking imprint of teeth (*Merc; Pod; Rhus*).

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Taste as of rotten eggs (*Arnica*).

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Sensation as if something hung down from posterior nares; cannot get it up or down.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Deep pain in right side over liver, going through back. Stool yellowish brown, with bile.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Burning and swelling of the prepuce, with redness of meatus. Gonorrhoea (*Cann; Tussil*).

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text: Erythematous redness.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture, to third potency.

remedies.heading: ZINCUM METALLICUM
remedies.intro: The provings picture cerebral depression. The word "fag" covers a large part of zinc action. Tissues are worn out faster than they are repaired. Poisoning from suppressed eruptions or discharges. The nervous symptoms of most importance. Defective vitality. Impending brain paralysis. *Period of depression in disease*. Spinal affections. Twitchings. Pain, as if between skin and flesh. Great relief from discharges. Chorea, from fright or suppressed eruption. *Convulsions, with pale face and no heat*. Marked anaemia with profound prostration. It causes a decrease in the number, and destruction of red blood corpuscles. Repercussed eruptive diseases. In chronic diseases with brain and spinal symptoms, trembling, convulsive twitching and fidgety feet are guiding symptoms.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Weak memory. *Very sensitive to noise*. Averse to work, to talk. *Child repeats everything said to it*. Fears arrest on account of a supposed crime. Melancholia. *Lethargic, stupid*. Paresis.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Feels as if he would fall to left side. Headache from the smallest quantity of wine. Hydrocephalus. Rolls head from side to side. Bores head into pillow. *Occipital* pain, with weight on vertex. Automatic motion of head and hands. Brain-fag; headaches of overtaxed school children. *Forehead cool; base of brain hot*. Roaring in head. Starting in fright.

sections.heading: Eyes
sections.text: Pterygium; smarting, lachrymation, itching. Pressure as if pressed into head. Itching and soreness of lids and *inner angles*. Ptosis. *Rolling of eyes*. Blurring of one-half of vision; worse, stimulants. *Squinting*. Amaurosis, with severe headache. Red and inflamed conjunctiva; *worse, inner canthus*.

sections.heading: Ears
sections.text: Tearing, stitches, and external swelling. Discharge of fetid pus.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Sore feeling high up; pressure upon root.

sections.heading: Face
sections.text: *Pale* lips, and corners of mouth cracked. Redness and itching eruption on chin. Tearing in facial bones.

sections.heading: Mouth
sections.text: Teeth loose. Gums bleed. Gnashing of teeth. Bloody taste. Blisters on tongue. Difficult dentition; child weak; cold and restless feet.

sections.heading: Throat
sections.text: Dry; constant inclination to hawk up tenacious mucus. Rawness and dryness in throat and larynx. Pain in muscles of throat when swallowing.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Hiccough, nausea, vomiting of bitter mucus. Burning in stomach, heartburn from sweet things. *Cannot stand smallest quantity of wine. Ravenous hunger* about 11 am (*Sulph*). Great greediness when eating; cannot eat fast enough. Atonic dyspepsia, feeling as if stomach were collapsed.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Pain after a light meal, with tympanitis. Pain in spot beneath navel. Gurgling and griping; distended. Flatulent colic, with retraction of abdomen (*Plumb*). Enlarged, indurated sore liver. Reflex symptoms from floating kidney. *Griping after eating*.

sections.heading: Urine
sections.text: Can only void urine when sitting bent backwards. Hysterical retention. Involuntary urination when walking, coughing or sneezing.

sections.heading: Rectum
sections.text: Hard, small, constipated stool. *Cholera infantum*, with tenesmus; green mucous discharges. Sudden cessation of diarrhoea, followed by cerebral symptoms.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Testicles swelled, drawn up. Erections violent. Emissions with hypochondriasis. Falling off of hair (pubic). Drawing in testicles up to spermatic cord.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Ovarian pain, *especially left; can't keep still* (*Viburn*). Nymphomania of lying-in women. Menses too late, suppressed; lochia suppressed (*Puls*). Breasts painful. Nipples sore. Menses flow more at night (*Bov*). Complaints all *better during menstrual flow.* (*Eupion; Lach*). *All the female symptoms are associated with restlessness, depression, coldness spinal tenderness and restless feet*. Dry cough before and during menses.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Burning pressure beneath sternum. Constriction and cutting in chest. Hoarseness. Debilitating, spasmodic cough; worse, eating sweet things. Child grasps genitals during cough. Asthmatic bronchitis, with constriction, of chest. *Dyspnoea better as soon as expectoration appears*.

sections.heading: Back
sections.text: Pain in small of back. Cannot bear back *touched* (*Sul; Therid; Cinch*). Tension and stinging between shoulders. Spinal irritation. *Dull aching about the last dorsal or first lumbar vertebrae; worse sitting. Burning along spine. Nape of neck weary from writing or any exertion*. Tearing in shoulder-blades.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text:
Lameness, *weakness, trembling and twitching* of various muscles. Chilblains (*Agar*).
*Feet in continued motion; cannot keep still. Large varicose veins on legs*. Sweaty. Convulsions, *with pale face. Transverse pains*, especially in upper extremity. *Soles of feet sensitive*. Steps with entire sole of foot on floor.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.text: Cries out during sleep; body jerks; wakes frightened, stared. Nervous motion of feet when asleep. Loud screaming out at night in sleep without being aware of it. Somnambulism (*Kali phos*).

sections.heading: Skin
sections.text:
*Varicose veins*, especially of lower extremities (*Puls*). Formication of feet and legs as from bugs crawling over the skin, preventing sleep. Eczema, especially in the anaemic and neurotic. Itching of thighs and *hollow of knees*.
*Retrocession of eruptions*.

sections.heading: Fever
sections.text: Frequent, febrile shiverings down back. Cold extremities. Night-sweat. Profuse sweat on feet.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse*, at menstrual period, from touch, between 5 to 7 pm; after dinner, from wine. *Better*, while eating, discharges, and appearance of eruptions.

sections.heading: Relationship
Dose
sections.text: Second to sixth potency.

remedies.heading: ZINCUM VALERIANICUM
remedies.intro: A remedy for *neuralgia*, hysteria, angina pectoris, and other *painful* affections, notably in *ovarian affections*. Epilepsy without aura. Hysterical heart-pain. *Facial* neuralgia, violent in left temple and inferior maxillary. Sleeplessness in children. Obstinate *hiccough*.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Violent, neuralgic, *intermittent headaches*. Becomes almost insane with pain, which is piercing and stabbing. Uncontrollable sleeplessness from pain in head with melancholy.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: *Ovaralgia; pain shoots down limbs*, even too foot.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Severe pain in neck and spine. Cannot sit still; must keep legs in constant motion. Sciatic neuralgia.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First and second trituration. Must be continued for some time in treatment of neuralgia.

remedies.heading: ZINGIBER OFFICINALE
remedies.intro: States of debility in the digestive tract, and sexual system and respiratory troubles, call for this remedy. Complete cessation of function of kidneys.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Hemicrania; sudden glimmering before eyes; feels confused and empty. Pain over eyebrows.

sections.heading: Nose
sections.text: Feels obstructed and dry. Intolerable itching; red pimples.

sections.heading: Stomach
sections.text: Taste of food remains long, especially of bread and toast. Feels heavy, like from a stone. *Complaints from eating melons and drinking impure water. Acidity* (*Calc; Robinia*). Heaviness in stomach on awakening with wind and rumbling, great thirst and emptiness. Pain from pit to under sternum, worse eating.

sections.heading: Abdomen
sections.text: Colic, diarrhoea, extremely loose bowels. Diarrhoea from drinking bad water, with much flatulence, cutting pain, relaxation of sphincter. Hot, sore, painful anus during pregnancy. Chronic intestinal catarrh. Anus red and inflamed. Haemorrhoids hot, painful, sore. (*Aloe*).

sections.heading: Urinary
sections.text: Frequent desire tu urinate. Stinging, burning in orifice. Yellow discharge from urethra. Urine thick, turbid, of strong odor, suppressed. Complete suppression after typhoid. After urinating, continues to ooze in drops.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Itching of prepuce. Sexual desire excited; painful erections. Emissions.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Hoarseness. *Smarting below larynx*; breathing difficult. *Asthma*, without anxiety, *worse* toward morning. Scratching sensation in throat; stitches in chest. Cough dry, hacking; copious morning sputa.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Very weak in all joints. Back lame. Cramps in soles and palms.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: *Calad*.
Antidote: *Nux*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: First to sixth potency.

remedies.heading: ZIZIA AUREA
remedies.intro: Hysteria, epilepsy, chorea, hypochondriasis, come within the sphere of this remedy.

sections.heading: Mind
sections.text: Suicidal; depressed; laughing and weeping moods alternate.

sections.heading: Head
sections.text: Pressure on top, in right temple, associated with backache.

sections.heading: Male
sections.text: Great lassitude following coitus. Sexual power increased.

sections.heading: Female
sections.text: Intermittent neuralgia of left ovary. Acrid, profuse leucorrhoea, with retarded menses.

sections.heading: Respiratory
sections.text: Dry cough, with stitches in chest. Dyspnoea.

sections.heading: Extremities
sections.text: Unusual tired feeling. *Chorea, especially during sleep. Fidgety legs* (*Tarant*). Lameness in arms and spasmodic twitching.

sections.heading: Modalities
sections.text: *Worse, during sleep*.

sections.heading: Relationship
sections.text: Compare: *Agar; Stram; Tarant; Cicuta; Aethusa*.

sections.heading: Dose
sections.text: Tincture, to third potency.
